But, for Murphy, nothing ever works the way it should and he has big competition: Blat Jack, a super bounty hunter. Everything that can go wrong will go wrong! Relive the glory days of burlesque cartoons!

title: Bull Shark
description: When a young female swimmer is found eaten alive by the Sheriff, Spencer must track down and kill whatever is responsible for her murder – in this case, a hungry Bull Shark that has been brought up from the Texas coast by a local fisherman.

title: Bullet To Beijing
description: When British agent Harry Palmer loses his job because the Cold War is over, a Russian boss approaches him and tells Harry of his plan for Russia's future, which is threatened because a deadly biochemical weapon called the Red Death, has been stolen from him and he'll pay Harry to retrieve it.

description: Through a colorful mosaic of stories, this documentary film aims to demystify the world-famous French winemaking region and offers a rare insider glimpse into the lives of the passionate people working in Burgundy's wine industry.

title: Burial
description: A small group of Russian soldiers have the task of taking Hitler's discovered remains back to Stalin in Moscow. Starring Tom Felton.

title: Burying Yasmeen
description: One man's odyssey to put a ring on his dead ex-wife.

title: Butterfly Kisses
description: A filmmaker discovers a box of video tapes depicting a disturbing student film project about an urban legend known as Peeping Tom.

title: Ca$h
description: After a down-and-out couple finds a briefcase of money that solves all their problems, a menacing stranger forces them to commit a series of armed robberies to pay it all back.

title: Cage Dive

To ensure they stand out, they decide to travel to Australia where they will be documenting themselves taking part in a most extreme activity…Shark Cage Diving.

title: Calabria
description: Two undertakers must travel from north to south of Italy in their hearse to repatriate the dead body of a Calabrian emigrant who came to Switzerland to find work.

title: California King
description: When mattress store manager Perry's childhood crush Lynette announces she's leaving town, he panics. Desperate to prove himself, he and his reckless best friend Wyatt concoct a harebrained scheme to "rescue" her younger brother from a fake kidnapping—only to accidentally pull off a real one.

title: Calling for Love
description: When successful podcaster Samantha Desouza is re-assigned to host Heartwaves, a feel-good love song show with a segment that reunites lost loves, she is less than impressed – love isn’t her favourite topic right now.

title: Calm With Horses
description: Douglas 'Arm' Armstrong has become the feared enforcer for the drug-dealing Devers family, whilst also trying to be a good father. Torn between these two families, Arm's loyalties are tested when he is asked to kill for the first time.

title: Calvaire
description: The shocking cult classic is back. A stranded singer falls victim to a dangerously unhinged innkeeper determined to keep him captive.

title: Camp X-Ray
description: Hoping to escape her small town roots and make a difference in the world, a young woman joins the military and is soon assigned a guard position at Guantanamo Bay. Surrounded by hostility on both sides of the fence, she discovers her mission is far from the black and white ideal she expected.

title: Can You Keep A Secret?
description: On a return flight from a botched client meeting, Emma reveals all of her deepest secrets to a handsome stranger when her plane hits turbulence and she believes she is going to die. Emma thinks she will never see the guy again.

title: Cancel Christmas
description: Santa Claus is in deep trouble when, in this heartwarming family movie, he is charged with convincing three boys that the true meaning of Christmas is selfless giving - before Christmas Day. If he fails, he’s out of a job.

title: Canopy
description: Wartime, 1942. Singapore. An Australian fighter pilot shot down in combat awakens suspended in the treetops. As night devours day, he must navigate through the heart of a war-torn jungle, abruptly abandoning hope of victory in favour of a search for sanctuary.

title: Captain Abu Raed
description: Captain Abu Raed is a universal story of friendship, inspiration and heroism set in contemporary Jordan.

title: Captive
description: A group of stoners break into a house for a weekend party, but realize all is not well after finding a mysterious stranger held captive in the basement.

title: Car City Universe
description: Welcome to Car City, where cars and trucks live happily together. Follow the adventures of Tom the Tow Truck, always ready to help his friends,

title: Cara
description: Cara, a mentally troubled woman escaped from an institution, believes in a conspiracy against her. She plans horrific acts using her show's viewers, exploring mental health, abuse, and violence, leaving a disturbing trail.

title: Carol
description: Self-centered Solomon Lynch takes a journey through his past, present, and future. But it takes more than Christmas spirit to set things right in this story of hope, faith, and redemption.

title: Carrie
description: A sheltered high school girl unleashes her newly developed telekinetic powers after she is pushed too far by her peers.

title: Casamance
description: Spanish singer-songwriter Jairo Zavala embarks on a trip from Madrid to Casamance, Senegal, in search of the African sounds he inherited.

title: Cash Out
description: Professional thief Mason attempts his biggest heist with his brother, robbing a bank. When it goes wrong, they're trapped inside surrounded by law enforcement. Tension rises as Mason negotiates with his ex-lover, the lead negotiator.

title: Casino Jack
description: CASINO JACK lays bare the wild excesses and escapades of Jack Abramoff (Kevin Spacey), a man hell- bent on acquiring all that the good life has to offer.

title: Catch The Fair One
description: Native American boxer Kaylee (Kali Reis) embarks on the fight of her life when she goes undercover in a sex trafficking operation to seek answers and revenge against the men responsible for the disappearance of her sister.

title: Catfish
description: Film-makers Ariel Schulman and Henry Joost sense a story unfolding as they begin to film the life of Ariel’s brother, Nev. They have no idea that their project will lead to the most exhilarating and unsettling months of their lives as they unravel an intriguing Facebook mystery.

title: Catfish Christmas
description: A heartbroken young woman returns home for Christmas and feels the pressure of being single. Her loving and curious sister sets her up on a date with a handsome professional athlete.

title: Cave Club
description: Welcome to a land of adventure, exploration, and even dinosaurs. Join five intrepid friends as they discover the unexpected origins of some of today's most popular trends and tackle topics related to them.

title: Cell
description: When a mysterious cell phone signal causes apocalyptic chaos, an artist is determined to reunite with his young son in New England.

title: Ceremony
description: Entertaining romantic comedy about a young man who crashes the wedding of an older woman (Uma Thurman) he still loves.

title: Champions

title: Changeland
description: Brandon discovers his wife has been cheating just before surprising her with an anniversary vacation to Thailand, so he skips the confrontation and, instead, enlists his best friend to join him on a life-changing adventure.

title: Chantilly Bridge
description: Twenty-five years later, the same brilliant actresses from "Chantilly Lace", Linda Yellen's groundbreaking Sundance hit, return to bring their characters to life in "Chantilly Bridge."

title: Chaos
description: Two cops, a rookie and a grizzled vet, pursue an accomplished bank robber.

title: Chapter 27
description: A film about Mark David Chapman in the days leading up to the infamous murder of Beatle John Lennon.

title: Chariot
description: In this dark and twisted thriller, John Malkovich stars as Dr. Karn, an odd, eccentric specialist who guides unknowing patients through the reincarnation transition.

title: Charisma
description: A burned-out negotiator botches a tense negotiation, resulting in the deaths of the kidnapper and the businessman hostage.

title: Charming
description: A hilarious and music filled animation from the producer of 'Shrek'.

title: Chatroom
description: Aaron Taylor-Jonson, Imogen Poots, Daniel Kaluuya and Richard Madden star in this all too relevant psychological thriller about the dangerous and murky world of online chatrooms.

title: Cheap Thrills
description: Craig loses his low-wage job. He heads to a bar and encounters an old friend. The two are roped into a round of drinks by a wealthy couple who engages them in a series of innocent dares in exchange for money. It seems like easy and much needed money, but how far are they willing to go for money?

title: Chef
description: When Chef Carl Casper suddenly quits his job at a prominent Los Angeles restaurant, he is left to figure out what’s next. Finding himself in Miami, he teams up with his ex-wife, his friend and his son to launch a food truck.

title: Child 44
description: When Leo Demidov, a war hero but now disgraced member of the military police, uncovers evidence of a serial killer, he must work against the all-powerful Soviet regime in order to track him down before he strikes again.

title: Child's Play
description: A contemporary re-imagining of the 1988 horror classic, Child's Play follows Karen, a single mother who gifts her son Andy a Buddi doll, unaware of its sinister nature. When the doll suddenly takes on a life of its own, Andy unites with other neighborhood children to stop the maniacal toy.

title: Chimera Strain
description: A disturbed scientist freezes his children alive, while he races to cure their genetic disease.

title: China Aspirations
description: After China’s 20th National Congress, the country’s roadmap for the future has been the main focus of the international community.  China Aspirations offers a fresh interpretation of how China’s change over the years is set to shape its vision for the future.

title: China through the Lenses
description: China through the Lenses is a documentary which tells stories from the perspective of foreign photographers who came to the People’s Republic of China in different periods.

title: Chloe & Theo
description: Chloe, a young woman who has been searching for something to believe in, is living on the streets of New York City. She comes face to face with an Inuit Eskimo named Theo, who was sent By his elders to send a message to humankind.

title: Chosen
description: The year is 1944 and the Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands.

title: Christmas Coupon
description: Alison begins teaching ice skating students on a friend's frozen pond. On the first day of an ice skating class, Alison's old high school sweetheart Ivan, and now famous hockey player unexpectedly shows up when he brings his niece for her skating lessons.

title: Christmas in Big Sky Country
description: Becca teams up with the oil company’s new PR rep, Logan Johnston, to get her brother-in-law safely home for the holidays.

title: Christmas in Maple Hills
description: Valerie teams with a handsome doctor to solve the mystery of who actually owns her family land.

title: Christmas In The Rockies
description: After her father is in a timber accident, Katie enters a lumberjack competition to save her family’s business and finds love along the way.

title: Christmas in the Wilds
description: Buck and Jessica's merry little Christmas together takes a dangerous turn when their journey through the wild turns into a battle for survival.

title: Christmas In Wolf Creek
description: When the reindeer and star of the holiday play goes missing, new couple Sam and Austin set out to save Christmas—and their relationship.

title: Chubby Funny
description: Oscar thinks he's special. He isn't. He thinks it's everyone else's fault. It's not. Moving to London, he gives himself a year to break into showbiz, but ends up waylaid by the same old problems: friendships and finding ultimate fulfilment. Say what you like, but it's tough being 'Chubby Funny'.

title: Cinderella and Four Knights
description: Ha Won (Park So Dam) loses her mother in a tragic accident, and her father remarries. When her cruel stepmother moves in with them, she steals Ha Won’s college funds.

title: Cinema Futures
description: This film transcends the informative documentary on the digital evolution in the film industry, to rather spin a poetic essay on the future of this art through a concert of recognized voices such as Christopher Nolan, Martin Scorsese and Apichatpong Weerasethakul.

title: CittáGiardino
description: Sahid does not like to wait anymore in a centre for immigrants that is due to close soon. With the help of his friend Farouq he plots an escape plan…

title: City of Lies
description: A journalist follows a disgraced LAPD detective obsessed with discovering the truth behind the murders of Tupac Shakur and the Notorious B.I.G., and possibly bites off more than he can chew.

title: Cjamango
description: Two bandits attack Cjamango by stealing from him a large amount of gold he had won in a poker game. After numerous vicissitudes, Cjamango regains possession of it, but El Tigre once again succeeds in stealing it from him. The clash between gangs will be most violent.

title: Cjamango, The revenge
description: In a Mexican cemetery two men meet. One is a young man moved by strong intentions of revenge, the other is an elderly American gentleman named Cjamango. The latter, to calm the boy's strong desire for revenge, decides to tell him about his tragic life.

title: Clairevoyant
description: A yoga-practicing girl hires a TV crew to document her journey to enlightenment to self-discovery, comparing the past, her painful present, and the unspiritual scene in Los Angeles.

title: Class Rank
description: CLASS RANK is a funny and touching coming-of-age drama in the vein of Election, Easy A or Legally Blonde, from the director of Glee...

title: Classic Quotes by Xi Jinping
description: Through quotes from ancient Chinese literature, CGTN brings an entirely new avenue to discover the stories behind the classics and discuss the cultural foundation of the Chinese. The series will help viewers understand the Chinese wisdom to govern an evolving nation.

title: Claw
description: Two friends forced to spend the night in a ghost town find themselves hunted by a prehistoric predator.

title: Clay Pigeons
description: A unique comedy with a darkly disturbing and terrifying twist, starring Oscar Winner Joaquin Phoenix (Joker).

title: Cleaner
description: Crime thriller starring Samuel L. Jackson as Tom Cutler, a former cop who now works as a professional crime scene cleaner. When he's called to sanitise a suburban home after what appears to be a routine homicide, Tom later discovers he may have unknowingly helped cover up a murder.

title: ClearMind
description: When a grieving mother uses her virtual reality simulation to crash the weekend getaway of her former friends, what begins as an exercise in therapeutic healing becomes a night of deadly revenge.

title: Clink
description: A drama set in the fictional women’s prison Bridewell, "Clink" focuses on the emotional heart of a community of women who are forced to confront their own realities.

title: Close Range
description: A rogue soldier turned outlaw is thrust into a relentless fight with a corrupt sheriff, his obedient deputies, and a dangerous drug cartel in order to protect his sister and her young daughter.

title: Close to You
description: Sam (Elliot Page) hasn't been home since his transition. After four years in Toronto, he takes a long-dreaded trip back to his hometown for his father's birthday.

title: Closer to God
description: A genetic scientist successfully clones the first human being, a baby girl named Elizabeth, but his work is soon threatened by a dark secret, a secret that threatens to destroy everything and everyone precious to him.

title: Cloudy Times
description: Arami returns from Europe to Paraguay to take care of her elderly mother, who suffers from epilepsy and Parkinson. Clouds are over this house. The future is uncertain.

title: Code 46
description: Dystopian sci-fi thriller from BAFTA winner Michael Winterbottom. In the near future, insurance fraud investigator William Geld (Oscar winner Tim Robbins) arrives in Shanghai to investigate a forgery ring for "papelles," futuristic passports that record people's identities and genetics.

title: Coffin Full of Dollars
description: There's a frontier feud on the border of Mexico. Outlaw Hagen's brothers have been killed by Nevada's Kid's family.

title: Coherence
description: Eight friends gather for a dinner party to watch a passing comet. Unbeknownst to them, this beautiful, once-in-a-lifetime astrological event is about to set off a catastrophic chain of events.

title: Cold Brook
description: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns.

title: Cold Skin
description: A young man who arrives at a remote island finds himself trapped in a battle for his life.

title: Colin And Justin's Home Heist
description: Hang on to your knickers…  Because Britain’s most outrageous decorating duo is determined to overhaul the country’s tackiest interiors...  And teach Canadians a thing or two about good design!

title: Collision
description: A couple is honeymooning in Morocco when the bride’s other lover pops up with his own violent agenda. Travelling the same route: a cutthroat diamond smuggler is being carted off to prison and an enigmatic woman is traveling with a baby.

title: Come Early Morning
description: A thirty-something southern woman searches for love, despite the burdens she carries with her.

title: Comet
description: Comet explores the six-year relationship between Dell and Kimberly, as it skips around between five pivotal moments.

title: Coming home in the dark
description: A family's outing descends into terror when teacher Alan Hoaganraad, his wife Jill and stepsons Maika and Jordon explore an isolated coastline. An unexpected meeting with a pair of drifters thrusts the family into a nightmare when they find themselves captured.

title: Commando Leopard
description: Under the leadership of the enigmatic Enrique Carrasco, known as "the Leopard", a small group of guerrillas organize resistance to fight against the dictatorship that has long brought corruption, brutality and exploitation in their country.

title: Con Man
description: The unbelievable true story of Barry Minkow, the youngest person ever to defraud Wall Street and who by the age of 21 was worth a staggering 100 million dollars.

title: Conan The Barbarian
description: The most legendary Barbarian of all time is back. A quest that begins as a personal vendetta for the fierce Cimmerian warrior soon turns into an epic battle against hulking rivals, horrific monsters, and impossible odds, as Conan realizes he is the only hope of saving the great nations of Hyboria.

title: Condor's Nest
description: A decade after the fall of Nazi Germany, an American aviator travels across South America in search of war criminals.

title: Conduct Unbecoming
description: A company of British soldiers in colonial India is shaken when the widow of their most honored hero is assaulted. A young officer must defend a fellow lieutenant from the charges in an unusual court-martial, while investigating the deepening mystery behind the attack.

title: Confession
description: An up-and-coming district attorney takes on the case of a young woman who has accused three men of sexual assault. She puts her career on the line in order to uncover a deeper web of mystery, murder and deception.

title: Confidential Informant
description: A police detective suffering from cancer makes a deal with an informant to get killed in the line of duty, so his family can receive the hefty death benefits from the department.

title: Connected
description: Genaro is a young man growing up in a neighborhood that is controlled by the Mafia. Despite the teachings of his family and church the lure of mystery, power and intrigue are too powerful for Genaro to resist and he soon finds himself caught up in a web of danger, contradiction and betrayal.

title: Containment
description: Neighbors in an apartment complex realize they were sealed inside by strangers in hazmat suits. The quarantined startturning against each other in an adrenaline-fuelled fight for survival.

title: Continuum
description: After the disappearance of a young scientist on a business trip, his son and wife struggle to cope, only to make a bizarre discovery years later - one that may bring him home.

title: Control
description: British Home Secretary Stella Simmons drives home one night while engaging in an affair with the Prime Minister. A mysterious man remotely hijacks her self-driving car, forcing her on a rampage through London.

title: Conversations With Other Women
description: When a man (Aaron Eckhart) and a woman (Helena Bonham Carter) flirt with each other at a wedding reception, the sexual tension seems spontaneous. As they break from the party to a hotel room, the flirtation turns into a night filled with passion and remorse.

description: Hardworking & optimistic television producer, Kelly, doesn’t have time for love. Along with her mentor Amanda, Kelly dives into another season of the Little Gourmet, a kids cooking show, when hot-headed Chef Stephen is dropped into Kelly’s life as a last minute replacement host.

title: Corneil & Bernie
description: Bernie, an eccentric teenager meets Corneil, a dog of exceptional intelligence. The dog is the brain of the two and has to continuously save his dogsitter from the trouble he lands himself in.

title: Corumbiara
description: After a massacre perpetrated by Landowners in Corumbiara, a municipality in western Brazil, the indigenist and filmmaker Vicent Carelli faces great political and economic interests with the mission of obtaining evidence of the existence of the indigenous community that was victim.

title: Cosmic Dawn
description: After witnessing the alien abduction of her mother as a child, Aurora joins the UFO cult "The Cosmic Dawn". Now moved on from the cult, Aurora is forced to confront her past and pursue the ultimate truth about The Cosmic Dawn.

title: County Line: All In
description: Sheriff Alden Rockwell teams up with a big city cop to investigate the murder of a not-so-popular lawyer.

title: County Line: No Fear
description: Alden Rockwell's retirement plans are interrupted when a crime syndicate threatens the family of neighbouring York County sheriff Joanne "Jo" Porter, starting a chain reaction that turns into a battle for the future of the two counties.

title: Courage of One
description: Based on a true story of bravery and courage! The year was 1918. Aníbal Milhais was one of 75,000 Portuguese soldiers sent to Flanders in defense of the Western Front.

title: Crash
description: Los Angeles residents who live vastly separate lives collide in interweaving stories of race, loss and redemption.

title: Crazy Beautiful Weddings
description: Follow Wedding Planner Lynzie Kent as she and her team create one-of-a-kind wedding celebrations that capture the true spirit, personality and unique love story of every couple they work with.

title: Crime Story
description: Troubled Hong Kong CID agent Eddie Chan (Jackie Chan) is assigned to ensure the safety of a controversial businessman who is then kidnapped. An investigation is launched but, unbeknownst to Chan - his new partner, Inspector Hung isn't who he seems.

title: Crimebusters
description: Two penniless friends decide to rob a store--but end up instead in a police office where they are drafted as new recruits. Starring Terence Hill and Bud Spencer.

title: Crock of Gold: A Few Rounds with Shane MacGowan
description: Crock of Gold is the definitive feature documentary on Irish musical icon, Shane MacGowan, best known as the lead singer of The Pogues.

title: Cross and Banner
description: Every two years, the small town of Beverungen, in the middle of Germany, celebrates with particular vigour its “Schützenfest“, the traditional Marksmen's Festival.

title: Crossfire
description: Jonas ‘Malo’ Moldanado (Curtis ‘50 Cent’ Jackson) is a fresh faced recruit in the NYPD, taken under the wing of a corrupt police chief Sarcone (Robert DeNiro) Malo get dragged deeper and deeper into a world of drugs, violence and crime.

title: Crypto
description: With the current rise of cryptocurrency, people find ways to exploit the system and the global economy. After discovering evidence of fraud, a young agent named Martin is tasked with following a long trail of corruption and theft.

title: Cup of Cheer
description: In a comedic shakeup of every cheesy Christmas movie, a big city journalist goes to a small town for the holidays and finds herself in an unlikely romance with the owner of a struggling hot cocoa shop.

title: Cupid For Christmas
description: Hoping to land a promotion and become the new Cupid, his hapless apprentice, Ruby, is tasked with finding the perfect match for their most hopeless case yet.

title: Curse of the Macbeths
description: In their quest for power, Macbeth and Lady Macbeth engage in murder and mayhem to attain the Crown in this modern-day version of Shakespeare's famous story.

title: Curtain Call
description: With opening night fast approaching, a beloved Broadway star must overcome insurmountable odds to deliver the performance of a lifetime.

title: Cut Bank
description: Dwayne McLaren (Liam Hemsworth) dreams about escaping small town life in Cut Bank, Montana,the coldest spot in the nation, with his vivacious girlfriend Cassandra (Teresa Palmer).

title: Cypher
description: Thrown into the high-stakes world of corporate espionage, Morgan (Jeremy Northam), a disenchanted accountant turned spy, teams up with a mysterious colleague (Lucy Liu) on a mission to protect themselves from their ruthless boss.

title: Céline
description: Céline tells the unforgettable love story of one of the most compelling celebrity couples of all time and chronicles the rise to fame of the world's greatest pop superstar.

title: D13: District 13
description: Paris, 2013. Elite officer and martial arts expert Damien faces his most dangerous mission: recovering a weapon of mass destruction stolen by a powerful gang in the walled-off District 13.

title: Daida back to the ocean
description: Daida Ruano Moreno, 18 times World Champion, tells her fight against her most difficult rival: a Cancer that almost took away not only her Life, but her most personal and intimate dream…

title: Danger Zone
description: An American mining engineer (Billy Zane, "Titanic") gets involved in a civil war and international conspiracy in Africa. Featuring Robert Downey Jr.

title: Dangerous Beauty
description: In the late 1500s, as mistresses to Venice's important men, women lived a regal lifestyle, and were encouraged to read and study at a time when such education was forbidden for most woman.

title: Daniel's Gotta Die
description: After his father dies, Daniel Powell travels to the Cayman Islands to try to reconnect with the rest of his family. His plan hits a snag though when his siblings decide to try to kill him for his inheritance. Trapped, he'll learn what family means - even if it kills him.

title: Danny. Legend. God.
description: A British journalist travels to Bulgaria to film a crime documentary about the meteoric rise of a local businessman, but the project’s subject has different plans, in this thrilling and chaotic comedy about a larger-than-life personality.

title: DannyBoy
description: The film tells the tale of anxious stutter-prone,18 year-old Daniel Buckley whose struggle to find love is constantly depth-charged by anxiety, including a bad stutter that becomes chronic around girls he fancies.

title: Daphne
description: Daphne is a young woman negotiating the tricky business of modern life. Caught in the daily rush of her restaurant job and a nightlife kaleidoscope of new faces, she is witty, funny, the life of the party. Too busy to realise that deep down she is not happy.

title: Dark Asset
description: A charming guy attempts to pick up a woman in a bar by spinning a tale involving spies, implanted microchips and the dangerous military scientist hunting him.

title: Dark Harvest
description: Every Halloween, The October Boy, a supernatural spectre, rises from the cornfields and makes his way toward town, where gangs of teenage boys eagerly await their chance to confront the legendary nightmare in an annual rite of life and death.

title: Dark Signal
description: Deep in the heart of the isolated Welsh valleys, an eerie hush spreads throughout the deserted wilds. Stranded and terrified, single mother, Kate, finds herself entangled in an ill-thought-out plan: a midnight robbery about to take a dangerous turn.

title: Dark Tide
description: Halle Berry plays a traumatised shark expert who returns to deep waters after an almost fatal encounter with a great white shark. Battling her fears, she leads a thrill-seeking businessman on a dive into the dangerous "Shark Alley".

title: Darklands
description: A newspaper reporter is lured into a conspiracy of pagan rituals and human sacrifice when he investigates the death of a steelworker.

title: Darkness Falls
description: After his wife's suicide, Detective Jeff Anderson becomes convinced that she has been murdered. Obsessed with his investigation, he finds out that his wife was the victim of a team of father-and-son serial killers and sets out to stop them.

title: Darkness of Man
description: An Interpol operative is assigned to protect young Jayden, the son of an informant killed in a routine raid gone wrong. Years later, he finds himself once again protecting Jayden from a group of merciless gangs in an all-out turf war.

title: Daruma
description: Patrick (bitter wheelchair user) enlists the help of his cantankerous neighbor Robert (double amputee) to transport the four-year-old daughter he never knew he had to live with her maternal grandparents on the other side of the country.

title: Dashcam
description: A psychological thriller following Jake, a reclusive news editor, who is inadvertently sent secret dashcam video evidence that points to a possible conspiracy and cover-up involving high-ranking government officials.

title: Date & Switch
description: High school seniors Michael and Matty have been best friends since 3rd grade. Still virgins, they make a pact to help each other "score" before Senior Prom. But their mission takes an unexpected turn when Matty announces that he's gay.

title: Date Movie
description: Hopeless romantic Julia Jones (Alyson Hannigan), has finally met the man of her dreams, the very British Grant Funkyerdoder (Adam Campbell).

title: Dating My Past
description: A couples therapy expert thinks back on what she’s learned from her relationships with three exes: one with whom she can’t deny the chemistry, one a sensitive artist, and one that’s seemingly too perfect.

title: Datsche
description: Valentine, a New York actor, inherits a 'datcha' on a garden allotment in East Germany and goes to spend the summer there.

title: Daughters of the Sexual Revolution: The Untold Story of the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders
description: Made by Academy Award-nominated director Dana Adam Shapiro, this intrepid film tells the story of the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders boom as a metaphor for the American sexual revolution at its climactic moment.

title: Dawn
description: Palestine in 1947: Four comrades in arms pressure the young Elisha to overcome his moral qualms and fully commit to the armed struggle for the establishment of a Jewish state.

title: Daybreakers
description: As the human population nears extinction, vampires must capture and farm every remaining human, or find a blood substitute before time runs out. However, a covert group of vampires makes a remarkable discovery, one which has the power to save the human race.

title: Days of Violence
description: During the last months of the Civil War, Joe's brother is unjustly killed by Clifford, a captain in the Northen army. Joe decides to join a group of Southerners determined to resist till the end.

title: Dead Man Down
description: When the body of a gang member is discovered in the freezer of crime boss Alphonse's (Terrence Howard) mansion - a clear message has been sent… or has it?

title: Dead on Arrival
description: A pharmaceutical sales rep visits a small town in Louisiana on business. He finds himself in a dark world of corruption and murder with only 24 hours to live, running from the police, the mob and a sheriff who wants him dead.

title: Dead Zone
description: An elite team of soldiers who, to stop the collapse of humanity, descend on a radiation-poisoned town and perform the ultimate stealth mission using high-tech armor and weapons.

title: Deadfall
description: When Joe Dolan (Michael Biehn) accidentally kills his father in a scam gone bad, his dying words lead Joe to his Uncle Lou (James Coburn). Lou is working on a con worth more than $2 million in diamonds.

title: Deadly Cuts
description: Deadly Cuts follows the stylists of a Dublin hair salon who become accidental vigilantes as they take on a local gang threatening their community.

title: Deadly Inferno
description: During some extensive renovations on an eight-storey office building, a major gas leak leads to a terrible explosion, trapping the injured staff in a fiery maze. Can the brave firefighters provide a safe exit from this deadly inferno?

title: Deadly Sisters
description: On January 18, 2003, police, alerted by a frantic call from a distraught pair of teenage girls, arrived at the girls Toronto area town house to find their mother dead. It appeared the 44-year-old alcoholic, having slipped into a booze-and-pill stupor, drowned in her own bathwater.

title: Dear Zoe
description: When Tess and her family suffer an unimaginable loss, she finds support from a surprising source: her biological father - a lovable slacker from the wrong side of the tracks - and the charming but dangerous juvenile delinquent next door.

title: Death Knows No Time
description: A Mexican peasant evicted from his land becomes an enraged outlaw. He is finally arrested and sent to prison.

title: Death of a Gentleman
description: Two cricket journalists set out to see whether Test cricket has a future. In so doing they discover a conspiracy which starts at the highest echelons of cricket administration and politics.

title: Death of a Ladies' Man
description: Inspired by the work of Leonard Cohen and set to some of his most beloved music. Death Of A Ladies’ Man tells the story of the womanising poetry professor, Samuel O’Shea (Gabriel Bryne), who spirals when he realises that he is suffering from hallucinations.

title: Death of Me
description: A dream vacation in the South Pacific becomes a torturous nightmare in Death of Me, a high stakes horror from director Darren Lynn Bousman.

title: Decoding Annie Parker
description: At nineteen, Annie Parker has lost her father and her mother and older sister to breast cancer. Although happily married to Paul and expecting her first child, something just isn’t quite right...

title: Deep Space
description: Two years ago, a deep space mining vessel went dark and has been drifting through space since. Though the suspicion is that the crew killed each other, what truly happened is a mystery and why they would kill each other even less clear.

title: Defining Moments
description: Defining Moments is a highly comedic film about that one single moment in time that changes you from who you were to who you'll be. Starring Burt Reynolds.

title: Deinfluencer
description: A cheerleader is imprisoned and made to jump through social media challenges for a seemingly motivated kidnapper - but does he want more than he is telling her?

title: Demonic
description: A group of teenage ghost hunters travel to a supposedly haunted house in an attempt to summon spirits from the dead. After performing a Seance, something goes drastically wrong and they are violently killed over the course of the night.

title: Demonic
description: Demonic is a supernatural possession horror which follows a young woman who unleashes a terrifying demon as she enters the mind of her comatose, serial killer mother...

title: Depuis Mediapart
description: By installing his camera in the heart of the editorial office of the online journal Mediapart, before, during and after the French presidential election of 2017, Naruna Kaplan de Macedo was able to follow the daily lives of those who work there.

title: Derailed
description: On a hijacked train carrying bio-weapons, a secret agent (action icon Jean-Claude Van Damme) must become a one-man army to stop the terrorists and save everyone on board.

title: Derek's Dead
description: Two former best friends (who currently hate each other) are forced to reconnect when their third former best friend (who they also hate) tasks them with spreading his ashes. There’s only one problem: they couldn’t care less.

title: Desert Jewel: Dunhuang
description: Dunhuang is a city that has stood in the desert for over two thousand years. The Silk Road turned it into a cultural melting pot where East met West, giving birth to the world-renowned "Eastern Treasure Trove of Art"—the Mogao Caves.

title: Despite the Falling Snow
description: In 1950s Moscow, communist Katya secretly spies for the Americans in the Cold War arms race. When she lands her biggest assignment, stealing secrets from rising government star Alexander, the last thing she expects is to fall in love with him.

title: Destination Wedding
description: Forced to tolerate each other for a few days, two cynical wedding guests strike an unexpected alliance.

title: Detachment
description: A substitute teacher who drifts from classroom to classroom finds a connection to the students and teachers during his latest assignment.

title: Devil in the Dark
description: When two estranged siblings go on a family bonding hunting trip, a dark and evil entity from their past stalks them through the country side. But something from the past is drawing one brother deeper into the woods.

title: Devil's Gate (Abduction)
description: Set in the small town of Devil's Gate, North Dakota, the film examines the disappearance of a local woman and her young son. Schull plays an FBI agent who helps the local sheriff  search for answers.

title: Diana
description: Celebrated and adored by millions, she was the Queen of people’s hearts, yet the bittersweet story of the last man to truly capture hers has never before. In a story that until now has remained untold, Diana introduces a time in the Princess’s life that was important in shaping her final years...

title: Diggers
description: Paul Rudd and Sarah Paulson star in this coming-of-age story following four working-class friends growing up in The Hamptons, New York, as clam diggers in 1976, following in the footsteps of their fathers and grandfathers.

title: Dimension Slip
description: Kate, a troubled young women wakes up in a parallel dimension and assumes her double's identity in order to solve her attempted murder.

title: Dinner with Friends
description: Molly and Abbey, along with their crew of close friends and acquaintances, host a dysfunctional, comical and chaotic Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Diplo: The Mighty Dinosaur
description: When his vibrant jungle home begins to vanish into a strange, colourless void, Diplo, a small but courageous young Diplodocus, sets out on a daring quest across time and space to uncover the truth behind the mysterious force stealing their world.

title: Dirty Paradise
description: One last piece of South America belongs to Europe: French Guyana - where the native Wayna Indians live in an almost paradisiacal world. But criminal gold diggers occupy and pollute the land with mercury, through their primitive extraction techniques.

title: Disappearance at Lake Elrod
description: A year after the disappearance of Charlie's daughter, another girl from Elrod, Georgia, goes missing. Charlie believes the cases are connected.

title: Disciple of Gravity
description: Extreme sports professional and base-jumper, Johnny Korthuis, jumps from a 500-foot bridge and suffers a parachute malfunction, hitting the water below at 120 miles per hour.

title: Discovering Canary Islands
description: Discovering Islands is an adventure reality series that uncovers some of the most incredible and extraordinary myths in the world by totally immersing the contestants in local culture and traditions.

title: Distorted
description: Lauren (Christina Ricci) and her husband Russell (Brendan Fletcher) move into The Pinnacle, a luxury high-rise boasting the latest design features and integrated security systems.

title: Django and Sartana's Showdown in the West
description: A gang of vicious outlaws lead by the crazed Black Burt Keller abduct Jessica Colby and decide to flee to Mexico. Shrewd bounty hunter Django and saintly roving gunslinger Sartana join forces to rescue the poor lass from the gang's vile clutches.

title: Django the last killer
description: A man saves the life of an assassin responsible for trying to kill him. The assassin teaches him how to shoot and is finally killed himself.

title: Dobermann
description: An all-guns-blazing cult crime thriller starring Vincent Cassel, Monica Bellucci and Romain Duris, with music from The Prodigy. A crook known as Dobermann has a soft spot for guns, and he loves using them - especially to rob banks.

title: Doe
description: A man wakes up with no memory of his past but the ability to speak dozens of languages fluently. After finding a clue about his former self, he will race against time to discover his true identity.

title: Dog Days
description: “What is it about dogs that brings us so much joy?”  Lives are about to change forever, when human and canine paths intertwine in sunny Los Angeles. There’s Elizabeth, a news anchor in her 30’s, who not only having to deal with a bad breakup, is struggling to cheer up her depressed dog Sam.

title: Dogtanian and the Three Muskehounds
description: Dogtanian is an ambitious young swordsman who dreams of becoming a hero and joining the legendary Muskehounds. After proving his skills and earning their trust, he and the three Muskehounds must defend the King from the villainous Cardinal Richelieu’s secret plot to seize power.

title: Dogtooth
description: Winner of Un Certain regard at Cannes, shocking and brutal as it is humorous, elegant and entertaining, Dogtooth is a significant piece of bold and inventive cinema.

title: Don Q
description: Don Q, a Little Italy resident, imagines himself as a powerful mafia boss aiming to restore the neighborhood's values. The return of a ruthless ex-con challenges Q's delusion, embroiling him and a loyal recruit in a turf war over the area.

title: Don't Say A Word
description: When Dr. Nathan Conrad's daughter is kidnapped, a secret held by one of his catatonic patients may be his only hope.

title: Don't Take Me Home
description: Don't Take Me Home isn't just the story of one of the smallest countries in the history of the game getting to the final rounds of a major tournament, it's the story of a whole country and its people, for so long left in the shadows, finally finding their place in the sun.

title: Don't Tear Yourself Apart
description: A few years ago, Carol, endured a traumatizing event. Haunted for years and fed by the hunger for revenge, she must to do the unthinkable to find the man responsible for it all. Will she recognize who she has become before it's too late?

title: Donkeyote
description: Manolo and his donkey Gorrión plan a journey to the West.

title: Dorothy and Toto's Storytime: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
description: Take a ride with Dorothy and her best pal Toto as they share their favorite adventures in the magical land of Oz. It's Dorothy And Toto’s Storytime: The Wonderful Wizard Of Oz!

title: Double Blind
description: After a drug trial goes wrong, seven test subjects learn that falling asleep means death. Trapped in a remote facility, panic sets in as they turn on each other. Claire must lead the group, find a way out, and stay awake to survive.

title: Double Eagle Ranch
description: Adhering to the last wishes of his grandmother, Marc convinces his ex, Lindsay, to help him spread her ashes at her mountain cabin. But when another, happier couple shows up, having booked the cabin weeks earlier, the awkward foursome must share.

title: Double Trouble
description: Two Brazilian billionaires hire a pair of look-alikes to temporarily take their place and find out who is trying to assassinate them.

title: Dovbush
description: 18th century. In the Carpathians, under foreign rule, the Dovbush brothers become legendary outlaws. But greed divides their destinies: Oleksa chooses the freedom of the people, his brother only money.

title: Down a Dark Hall
description: Five emotionally fragile teens are committed to Blackwood, a mysterious school for gifted and disturbed girls. Mesmerized by the intense head mistress Madame Duret, at first they think they have found a place where they can finally flourish academically and artistically...

title: Down With Love
description: In 1963 New York, a female advice columnist who has sworn off love falls for a journalist-ladies' man who's decided to entrap her.

title: Dr. Bird's Advice for Sad Poets
description: In the emotionally charged, wild and humorous world of sixteen-year-old James Whitman, we see his struggle to overcome anxiety and depression by seeking advice from Dr. Bird - an imaginary pigeon therapist - in the wake of his sister's disappearance.

title: Drag Becomes Him
description: Through an intimate visit to the dressing room of Jinkx Moonson we discover how this working-class boy managed to become an internationally acclaimed drag performer.

title: Dragon Lord
description: Dragon (Jackie Chan) and Bull (Mars) are childhood friends who spend most of their free time chasing after local girls. When a gang of smugglers start sending precious Chinese artefacts to westerners the mischievous duo take on the gang together.

title: Dragons Forever
description: Three successful Hong Kong lawyers are hired by a chemical company of questionable ethics and must eventually make a difficult decision when their employer's motives become clear.

title: Dreamin' Wild
description: What if a childhood dream suddenly came true - but thirty years later? That's what happened to singer/songwriter Donnie Emerson. His dream of success suddenly - and unexpectedly - came true but only as he approached 50 years old.

title: Drift
description: In '70s Australia, two brothers battle killer waves, small town prejudice, and a ruthless biker gang to kick start the modern surf industry.

title: Drive
description: DRIVE is the story of a Hollywood stunt driver by day (Ryan Gosling), a loner by nature, who moonlights as a top-notch getaway driver-for-hire in the criminal underworld. He finds himself a target for some of LA's most dangerous men after agreeing to aid the husband of his beautiful neighbour.

title: Drive Angry
description: Milton is mad, bad and Hell-bent on achieving his goal. He’s breaking all the rules, but what are they gonna do – not let him back in?

title: DriverX
description: Skidding into middle-age, a stay-at-home dad must drive for an Uber-like rideshare company (DriverX) to help support his working wife and two young daughters. But low pay and wild LA nights put an even greater strain on his marriage.

title: Drunk Bus
description: In this teen comedy, a directionless campus bus driver and a crazy Samoan body-guard strike up an unlikely friendship.

title: Drunk On Love
description: After a sheltered young man develops a crush on a stripper, he joins her Alcoholics Anonymous group just to be in the same room with her. Soon things become even more complicated as his meddling family and her psychopathic ex become involved!

title: Duchess
description: Duchess, a small-time crook, tries to enter the treacherous underworld of diamond trafficking and ends up left for dead when a deal goes wrong. Determined to seek retribution, she launches into an unwavering pursuit for vengeance.

title: Due Justice
description: An attorney with a military past hunts down the gang who killed his wife and took his daughter.

title: Durango Is Coming, Pay or Die
description: A debt collector gets involved in a dangerous situation when a corrupt businessman he retrieved 100,000 dollars for doesn't want to pay him his usual percentage for his services.

title: Dynamite Joe
description: In order to put an end to the numerous ambushes on the gold transports which are a real menace to the finances of the American government, the agent Joe Ford, called Dynamite Joe due to his liking for explosives, is entrusted with controlling the next transfer.

title: Earth Summit Mission
description: The documentary is a record of the second Chinese scientific expedition to Mount Qomolangma which took place in the summer of 2022.It involved around 200 scientists, led by Yao Tandong from the Institute of Tibetan Plateau Research under the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

title: Earth to Echo
description: Tuck, Munch and Alex are a trio of inseparable friends who long for adventure. One day the boys find a cryptic signal on their phones and convinced that it is part of something bigger they set out on a quest to find the source.

title: East West 101
description: “East West 101” centers on Zane Malik — a brilliant detective whose ability to connect with people helps him solve crimes. Malik is an Arab and proud of it, but as a Muslim detective in a post-9/11 world where just to be an Arab is to arouse suspicion and fear.

title: Eat Locals
description: Sebastian Crockett is in for the ride of his life when his night of desire with sexy, alluring cougar Vanessa turns into a fight for survival when she introduces him to some of her friends - a coven of hungry vampires - at a remote farmhouse.

title: Edge of War
description: A series of incidents around the world lead to greater conflict, placing the superpowers at one another's throats. Armies march, bombs rain down, soldiers storm the beaches. One family is caught up in the conflict, can they survive as total war is declared and nuclear weapons are unleashed?

title: Edison
description: Upon discovering a den of corrupt policemen, a fresh-faced journalist makes shaky allies in a jaded reporter and investigator for a powerful district attorney.

title: Eiffel
description: When Gustave Eiffel (Romain Duris) crosses paths with a mysterious woman from his past (Emma Mackey), their forbidden passion inspires him to build the iconic Eiffel Tower.

title: Eismayer
description: Inspired by true events, David Wagner's acclaimed drama EISMAYER tells the story of a secretly gay Military officer whose tough façade conceals a clandestine double life.

title: El Gringo
description: An American crosses the border into Mexico with a bullet in his arm and $2.3 million in cash, looking to head to Acapulco and retire on the beach. But he discovers quickly that executing his plan is easier said than done.

title: Electric Jesus
description: When a promoter sells a Christian metal band on the promise of a summer tour in 1986, their desire to "make Jesus famous" meets the complexities and confusion of personal ambition, youthful zeal, lifelong friendships, and first love.

title: Elektra
description: From the pages of Marvel Comics — creators of X-Men and Spider-Man — comes ELEKTRA, the first action-event movie of the year. In the ultimate battle between good and evil stands a warrior who makes the choice that tips the balance.

title: Elena
description: Petra heads to New York in search of her older sister after a long time of being separated. They are both movie actresses and heirs of the wounds of the Brazilian dictatorship. But Petra has only a few clues: home movies, newspaper clippings, a diary...

title: Eliminators
description: Martin Parker (Scott Adkins), a highly trained former DEA agent, is hiding in the witness protection program in London with his young daughter, Carly. His world is turned upside down when a group of thugs break into his home looking for hidden contraband.

title: Elite Force - B.R.I.
description: Homeless ex- soldiers from around the world are kidnapped and shipped to a mad scientist in London England who has plans to repair, restore and send them on dangerous missions to take vengeance against corruption around the world.

title: Ellie and Abbie (and Ellie's Dead Aunt)
description: School captain Ellie (Sophie Hawkshaw) has a serious crush on her classmate Abbie (Zoe Terakes), and is worrying over inviting her to the Year 12 formal.

title: Eloise
description: Four friends break into an abandoned insane asylum in search of a death certificate which will grant one of them a large inheritance. However, finding it soon becomes the least of their worries in a place haunted by dark memories.

title: Elvis & Nixon
description: Get ready for the astonishing true story of when Elvis Presley met President Nixon. At 6.30am on December 21st 1970, the King of Rock’n Roll showed up on the lawn of the White House to request a meeting with the most powerful man in the world, President Richard Nixon.

title: Emperor
description: Emperor, the son of an African king and a slave on an American plantation, can no longer tolerate the atrocities committed by whites against blacks.

title: Empire of the Sharks
description: On a future earth where 98% of the surface is underwater, a Warlord who controls an army of sharks meets his match when he captures the daughter of a mysterious shark caller.

title: Empire State
description: A New Yorker, takes up a job as a security with the Empire State Armoured Truck Company after failing to secure a job with the NYPD. After discovering that he is able to use his position to his advantage, he is drawn into an elaborate scheme to rob his company, resulting in the largest cash heist.

title: Enchantimals: A Royal Rescue
description: The Wonderwood Enchantimals are busy preparing for this year’s Snowy Valley Shimmer Snowflake Star Show when some unexpected royal guests throw off their party plans with a request for help!

title: Enchantimals: City Tails
description: Out of the Enchanted Ocean and into the City! Bree Bunny, Felicity Fox and Danessa Deer have a whole new world of adventures in store!

title: Enchantimals: City Tails Main Street
description: Sage and Patter are reunited with their friends in Wonderwood City, and they’ve just discovered a whole new place to explore in Main Street! Join the Enchantimals as they encounter a baking showdown, facing fears at the doctor's office, baby besties on the loose, and an epic bestie balloon chase!​

title: Enchantimals: Finding Home
description: Meet the Enchantimals™, a group of lovable girls who share a special bond with their animal besties. In “Finding Home”, things get a bit wild when the girls discover Patter Peacock™ lost in the woods.

title: Enchantimals: Glam Party
description: It’s time for the Enchantimals to strut their stuff in a fabulous fashion competition filled with new friends, new challenges and a whole lotta fierceness!

title: Enchantimals: Ocean Kingdom
description: Bree Bunny, Felicity Fox and Danessa Deer travel to the Enchanted Ocean Kingdom with Maura Mermaid for Caring Coral Day, but when Felicity accidentally removes the heart of the kingdom, a magical rainbow pearl, things begin to go awry!

title: Enchantimals: Royal Isle Ball
description: It’s finally time for the most enchanted part of the year in Royal Isle…the Royal Isle Ball! But first, the Enchantimals and their besties must prep for the big event!

title: Enchantimals: Secrets of Snowy Valley
description: Pristina Polar Bear’s desperate search for her missing bestie leads her to Snowy Valley, where a hot cocoa accident threatens to destroy an endangered glacier.

title: Enchantimals: Storybook shorts
description: Welcome to the home of Enchantimals! The Enchantimals dolls are lovable characters who share a special bond with their animal friends -- they’re always together, and they look alike, too! Each doll shares a ritual with her animal friends that celebrates their unique traits and personalities.

title: Enchantimals: Wildly Whimsical Tales
description: Welcome to the home of Enchantimals! The Enchantimals dolls are lovable characters who share a special bond with their animal friends -- they’re always together, and they look alike, too! Each doll shares a ritual with her animal friends that celebrates their unique traits and personalities.

title: Enchantimals: Wonderwood stories
description: Welcome to the world of Enchantimals! The Enchantimals dolls are lovable characters who have a very special bond with their animal friends – they are always together and even look alike!

title: Enchantimals™ Tales from Everwilde
description: Meet the Enchantimals and their animal besties.

title: End of days
description: Arnold plays hard-luck ex-cop Jericho Cane, who unwittingly finds himself caught in a terrifying struggle between the human Incarnation of evil and an innocent young woman chosen to be the mother of the Antichrist!

title: End of Sentence
description: An acclaimed and uplifting father-son story, starring Logan Lerman, John Hawkes and Sarah Bolger.

title: Enemies Closer
description: Deep within a forest on the US-Canadian border, two sworn enemies must work together to escape a ruthless drug cartel hell-bent on retrieving a drug shipment which went missing there.

title: Enemy Within
description: When a Japanese fighter pilot crash-lands on the tiny remote Hawaiian island of Ni'ihau, he is met with courtesy and traditional Hawaiian hospitality from the locals.

title: England is Mine
description: In 1970’s Manchester, Steven Morrissey (Jack Lowden – Dunkirk, A United Kingdom, ’71), an introverted, uncompromising teenager, finds himself frustrated with his working-class existence.

title: Enhanced
description: A young woman with enhanced abilities finds herself hunted down by a sinister government organization. But when an even stronger enhanced serial killer emerges on the scene, agents and mutants are forced to question their allegiances.

title: Enigma
description: March 1943 and the heroic code breakers at Bletchley Park face their worst nightmare when Nazi U Boats unexpectedly change their communication codes, placing an allied ship with 10,000 passengers in lethal danger.

title: Envisage
description: Witness a day through the eyes of three unique individuals. Their paths cross in a pivotal scene, each with a different interpretation, leaving the audience to decide what truly happened.

title: Epic Movie
description: Two of the warped writers of Scary Movie now set their parodic sights on the largest genre of them all: Hollywood’s big-budget, special effects-laden, blockbuster franchise films.

title: Errors of the Human Body
description: When a potentially lethal virus is created within his new lab, Dr Geoff Burton is shocked to discover he is not only the unwitting cause, but also its first victim.

title: Escape Plan
description: When a structural-security authority finds himself incarcerated in a prison he designed, he has to put his skills to escape and find out who framed him.

title: Escape Plan 2
description: Years after Ray Breslin fought his way out of the escape-proof prison called "The Tomb," he's organized a new top-notch, for-hire security force. But when one of his team members goes missing he must now decipher a way to break into the world's best hidden prison...

title: Escape Plan 3
description: The third and final installment of the unstoppable franchise, Escape Plan 3 sees screen legend Sylvester Stallone (The Expendables) kick this explosive action tale into high gear.

title: Escape Room
description: To celebrate his 30th Birthday, Tyler and his friends try out the latest in harmless fun, locking themselves in an exclusive escape room loaded with ominous clues. With their time ticking away, the group notices that the mysterious puzzles are becoming increasingly difficult and increasingly deadly.

title: Ettore Bassi: Stage and Race
description: Ettore Bassi is well known as an actor, but not everybody knows that he's also a professional hillclimb racing driver. Today his life is often divided between the stage and the racing track. In 2022, the two passions collide, and end up revealing much about the man and about his past...

title: Even Angels Eat Beans
description: In 1930s America, a wrestler and a brawler, after some vicissitudes, become part of the local underworld, but good natured, they soon side with the victims against those who cut them down.

title: Even Money
description: Gambling addiction brings three strangers together as it destroys each of their lives.

title: Evening
description: An all-star cast of the greatest actresses of our time - including Vanessa Redgrave, Meryl Streep, Toni Collette, Claire Danes, Natasha Richardson and Glenn Close - come together in this passionate and heartwarming story.

title: Everyone Wants To Be The Next Weismann
description: After living in the shadows of his old discovery, an art collector tries to find the next great artist, a Taiwanese painter based in Brookling. Will the sequels be as good or better than the original?

title: Everything Must Go
description: After delivering an inspiring presentation to his sales staff, Nick is fired for falling off the wagon one last time. He returns home to discover his wife has left him, changed the locks on their suburban home and dumped all his possessions out on the front yard.

title: Evidence
description: A terrifying take on found-footage-horror, this chilling film revolves around a team of detectives (Stephen Moyer: True Blood and Radha Mitchell: London has Fallen), who attempt to piece together what happened at the scene of a brutal massacre...

title: EVO
description: From the hottest supercars to everyday rides, this series explores every car that graces the road — all for the thrill of driving.

title: Exceptional Beings
description: Two supernatural beings question their divine status when they meet an ordinary woman with a disturbing essence: a human being who does not correspond to what their millennia of knowledge of humanity has taught them.

title: Execution
description: Clips, a bounty killer, is after one John Coler, who has fooled him, keeping all of a loot he should have shared with him. He finally catches his prey only to discover that the man is a Coler all right but not the expected one.

title: Extract
description: From the director of ‘Office Space’, and ‘Beavis and Butthead do America’, and starring the downright hilarious Jason Bateman, comes a comedy about sexual frustration, litigation, con-artistry, and castration…

title: Faceless
description: A disoriented and frightened man awakens in a hospital room to discover he's the recipient of a full face transplant.

title: Facing Ali
description: Ten boxers who faced legendary champion Muhammad Ali in the ring recount their epic battles against the world champion. With George Foreman, Joe Frazier, Ken Norton, more.

title: Fahrenheit 11/9
description: A provocative and comedic look at the times in which we live, exploring important questions of the Trump Era.

title: Fair Game
description: FAIR GAME is a riveting action-thriller based on the autobiography of real-life undercover CIA operative VALERIE PLAME (Naomi Watts), whose career was destroyed and marriage strained to its limits when her covert identity was exposed by a politically motivated press leak.

title: Fairytale Fun Force
description: Oh no! The mischievous Jabberwock has stolen the dreams of all the inhabitants of the galaxy! Enter Captain Snow White and the crew of the Fairytale Fun Force the superpowered team of fairytale heroes, King Arthur, Little Red Riding Hood, Pinocchio and Robin Hood!

title: Falling
description: John lives with his partner, Eric, and their daughter, Mónica in California, far from the traditional rural life he left behind years ago.

title: Falling For A Killer
description: An Assistant District Attorney’s younger sister’s fiancé seems too good to be true. As she learns of his dark past and his behavior becomes more bizarre, she must convince her family of the truth or risk none of them surviving.

title: Famous
description: Interracial brothers in the music business are opposites at life, love and sobriety.

title: Fanboys
description: A group of Star Wars fans travel to Skywalker Ranch to steal a copy of "The Phantom Menace" so that their terminally ill friend can see it before it's released in cinemas several months later.

title: Fast Food Nation
description: The hit satirical mockumentary taking a deep dive into the health issues and social consequences of America's love affair with fast food.

title: Fast Forward
description: Fast Forward is a five-episode documentary series that looks into the future through emerging technologies aimed to tackle some of the most vital challenges that the world is facing today.

title: Fasthand
description: A gang of former confederates lay siege to a Cavalry fort.

title: Father of Invention
description: Robert Axle (Kevin Spacey of AMERICAN BEAUTY, HORRIBLE BOSSES), an eccentric inventor-turned-egomaniacal-infomercial-guru, loses it all when one of his inventions maims thousands of customers.

title: Fear Inc.
description: A horror junkie and his friends sign up with a company that brings their customer's greatest fears to life.

title: Fear of Rain
description: Fear of Rain is a twisty, unsettling and terrifying horror thriller starring Katherine Heigl (Knocked Up, Firefly Lane), Madison Iseman (Jumanji franchise, Annabelle Comes Home) and Harry Connick Jr. (PS. I Love You), that will keep you guessing whether there is real horror hiding next door.

title: Fear the Night
description: Follows Iraqi war veteran Tess, as she prepares to strike back after a group of home invaders attack during her sister's bachelorette party, and she discovers that they are hellbent on not leaving any witnesses behind.

title: Fighting Demons
description: Ex-boxer and former alcoholic, Vian, just got out of prison after serving time for a fatal accident and is desperate for a fresh start. He moves in with his sister Bethley and her son with the understanding that he will not drink at all.

title: Film Stars Don't Die In Liverpool
description: Liverpool, 1978: What starts as a vibrant affair between a legendary femme fatale, the eccentric Academy Award®-winning actress Gloria Grahame, and her young lover, British actor Peter Turner (Bell), quickly grows into a deeper relationship, with Turner being the person Gloria turns to for comfort.

title: Filth
description: Bruce Robertson, a bigoted and corrupt policeman, is in line for a promotion and will stop at nothing to get what he wants. Enlisted to solve a brutal murder and threatened by the aspirations of his colleagues, Bruce sets about ensuring their ruin.

title: Final Kill
description: An aging protection specialist takes on one last job before retirement, protecting a couple who stole eight million dollars from a ruthless crime family.

title: Find Me Guilty
description: The true story of mobster Jack DiNorscio and the longest mafia trial in US history. Charged with drug dealing, Jack decides to defend himself in court, despite having no legal experience. Can this New York wise guy convince a jury he's not the monster he's portrayed as?

title: Finding Altamira
description: 1879, nine-year-old Maria Sautuola and her father, Marcelino, discover the first cave art and accomplished paintings of galloping bison. But Maria's mother, devout Conchita, is disturbed at the idea that prehistoric savages could have created such magnificent art.

title: Finding Hope Home
description: Filmmakers Wambui Ndegwa and Cole Lewis make the Kenyan reality visible through the story of a family that began adopting homeless children in Nairobi in 1996.

title: Finding Jesus
description: Join faith-fueled friends, Muggles and Joy, as they visit the beautiful Finding Jesus Bay, a place where Christian stories are told night and day! Guided by the sea's best storyteller, Professor Shark, they hear all about the endless kindness and boundless love of their Creator!

title: Finding Jesus 2
description: Join faith-fueled friends, Muggles and Joy, as they visit the beautiful Finding Jesus Bay, a place where Christian stories are told night and day! Guided by the sea's best storyteller, Professor Shark, they hear all about the endless kindness and boundless love of their Creator!

title: Finding Steve McQueen
description: Based on the true story of the Youngstown mob, President Richard Nixon, the FBI, and the biggest bank heist in US history! In 1972, a gang of likeminded thieves plan a heist to steal $30 million in illegal campaign contributions from the President's secret fund.

title: Fire on the Amazon
description: A photojournalist (Craig Sheffer) and an environmental activist (Sandra Bullock) investigate the murder of a famous environmentalist deep in the hot and steamy Amazonian jungle.

title: Firecracker
description: When a heist goes dramatically wrong, leaving a hostage in peril, an unlikely trio find themselves fighting for their lives and their sanity on bonfire night.

title: Firehouse Dog
description: Hollywood's most pampered pooch gets lost during a commercial shoot and ends up as the mascot for a local fire station.

title: First Date
description: After being conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, Mike's first date plans with girl-next-door Kelsey implode as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops, and a crazy cat lady.

title: First Daughter
description: Samantha Mackenzie wants what every college freshman desires: to experience life away from home and parents. It's not going to be easy, however, because home for Sam is the White House, and her dad is the President of the United States.

title: First Snow
description: A psychic's ominous predictions send a man into a tailspin.

title: Five Fingers For Marseilles
description: In this bold and brutal Western, a gang of outlaws fight over the fate of Marseilles.

title: Five Nights in Maine
description: A man, reeling from the tragic loss of his wife, travels to rural Maine to seek answers from his estranged mother-in-law, who is herself confronting grief. With David Oyelowo and Dianne Wiest.

title: Fixed
description: On the night low-level gambler, Daz Clemance is leaving Birmingham to start a crime-free life with his girlfriend in Spain, he's accused of fixing a bareknuckle fight in a warehouse. He is beaten, stabbed and locked in a cupboard.

title: Flag Day
description: John Vogel (Sean Penn) lives a double life as a counterfeiter, bank robber and con man in order to provide for his daughter Jennifer (Dylan Penn).

title: Flashback
description: After an encounter with a man from his past, Fred experiences terrifying flashbacks.

title: Flight 7500
description: A flight from Los Angeles to Tokyo is rocked by turbulence—and a terrifying force is unleashed in this spine-chilling journey into fear from the director of The Grudge.

title: Flirting With Love
description: Two male actors/close friends want to jumpstart their careers. They end up making a big shot producer think that they have a hot script that everyone wants to get their hands on.

title: Flow
description: Sam, 76, a retired poet, is thrown out of his own home by his daughter. His son Bo leaves him at an assisted living facility where old age takes over. Bored out of his mind he approaches another resident Carl and asks him to record a rap song.

title: Flypaper
description: A man caught in the middle of two simultaneous robberies at the same bank desperately tries to protect the teller with whom he's secretly in love.

title: Fog of War
description: At the height of World War II, an American pilot is ordered to spy on his fiancée's family who are suspected of being traitors. Starring John Cusack.

title: For a Few Dollars Less
description: A bank clerk and his cousin, a "general", join forces to track down a Mexican outlaw.

title: Forbidden City Cop
description: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities but a talent for making futuristic machines and must save the kidnapped emperor.

title: Forensic Files: A Special Tribute
description: 25 years after its premiere, "Forensic Files" remains the most successful true crime series of all time. Inspired by the O.J. Simpson murder case, the series succeeded 400 episodes proving science catches the bad guys.

title: Forever In My Heart
description: Jenna and Charlie found love in Ireland but their dreams drove them apart. Five years later, they reunite and Jenna has to decide where her heart belongs—back home or in the Emerald Isle.

title: Forever Lulu
description: A schizophrenic romantic tracks down her college sweetheart to help her find their son, given up for adoption, much to the dismay of his new wife. Starring Melanie Griffith and Patrick Swayze

title: Forgetting Dad
description: A man suffers a minor car accident, and a week later constructs a new identity, claiming he can't "remember" being a father. Nearly twenty years later, his amnesia persists, yet no brain damage or physical cause are ever found.

title: Forgotten Soldiers
description: A four-man team sent from headquarters to repair a com-station suddenly falls into a terrorist ambush on the peaks of a mountain.

title: Fortress
description: Fortress is an all-out-action cyber thriller from the producers of Lone Survivor and The Irishman and starring the action powerhouse Bruce Willis, Escape Plan II’s Jesse Metcalfe, One Tree Hill’s Chad Michael Murray and Shannen Doherty (90210, Charmed).

title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
description: Fortress: Sniper’s Eye is an explosive, all-out-action cyber-thriller starring action megastar Bruce Willis with Jesse Metcalfe (Escape Plan II) and Chad Michael Murray (Riverdale).

title: Fortunes of War
description: When a raid in Normandy goes wrong, a British commando team find themselves holed up in a barn, cut off from their comrades and encircled by Wehrmacht forces. Survival seems unlikely until an unexpected discovery offers them a chance at escape.

title: Foster Boy
description: A for-profit Foster care agency puts a known sex offender into the same foster home as a lawyer's young client, Jamal, with catastrophic results.

title: Found Footage
description: An acclaimed documentary crew quickly realizes they have triggered a real and terrifying rampage when sinister phenomena begin to unfold as they chronicle a budding filmmaker as he creates the world’s greatest “found footage” horror film on Bigfoot.

title: Four Came to Kill Sartana
description: Seven masked bandits kidnap young Susy, cousin of the mayor of Clayton City, Frank Clonny. Frank accepts the $15,000 ransom requested by the bandits and thinks of a plan which will permit him to recover the money and capture the outlaws.

title: Four Pistols For Trinity
description: A girl escapes death at the hands of some bandits and leaves, taking with her the valuable documents they wanted to take possession of. A journalist and a sheriff, who intends to find the bandits, protect her, but the showdown is near.

title: Frank & Penelope
description: A tale of love and violence when a man on his emotional last legs finds a savior seductively dancing in a run-down strip club. And a life most certainly headed off a cliff suddenly becomes redirected - as EVERYTHING is now worth dying for.

title: Free Birds
description: On a quaint, family-owned farm, a giant turkey flock lives a quiet, corn-stuffed life. All everyone cares about is feeding time and grazing in the sun and being in “Turkey Paradise.” Everyone, that is, except for Reggie, a whipsmart turkey who is an outcast among his flock.

title: Freeheld
description: Diagnosed with terminal cancer, decorated New Jersey detective Laurel Hester (Julianne Moore) wishes to leave her pension benefits to domestic partner Stacie Andree (Elliot Page).

title: Freehold
description: An oily, amoral estate agent is preyed upon by one of his victims, who quietly moves into his flat and, unseen, begins a deliciously malicious campaign of revenge.

title: Freshman Year
description: Lonely college freshman Alex has closed himself off from his peers, who all appear to have this whole "college thing" figured out. But everything changes one night when Alex takes a leap and attends a legendary frat party, where he forges a strong connection with Maggie.

title: From A House On Willow Street
description: For desperate petty crooks Hazel and her boyfriend Ade, kidnapping is their last chance to finally get a normal life. Their well-chosen target: a filthy rich diamond distributor's young and innocent daughter. For this reason, after six weeks of careful and meticulous planning...

title: From Below
description: A couple on a romantic getaway find themselves stranded at sea when a tropical storm sweeps away their villa. In order to survive, they are forced to fight the elements, while sharks circle below.

title: From Time to Time
description: In 1940s England, thirteen year old Tolly is sent to Green Knowe, the country estate of his grandmother, while his mother searches for any information concerning his missing in action father. Tolly soon finds that he can pass through time to witness the family stories Grandmother Oldknow tells him.

title: Frozen Ground
description: An Alaska State Trooper partners with a young woman who escaped the clutches of serial killer Robert Hansen to bring the murderer to justice. Based on actual events.

title: Fukushima 50
description: Workers at the Fukushima Daiichi facility in Japan risk their lives and stay at the nuclear power plant to prevent total destruction after the region is devastated by an earthquake and tsunami in 2011.

title: Funhouse Massacre
description: Six of the world's scariest psychopaths escape from a local Asylum and proceed to unleash terror on the unsuspecting crowd of a Halloween Funhouse whose themed mazes are inspired by their various reigns of terror.

title: Future My Love
description: A unique love story challenging our collective and personal utopias in search of freedom. At the brink of losing the idealistic love of her life, filmmaker Maja Borg takes us on a poetic road trip through the financial collapse...

title: Fuzzy the Hero
description: Tequila and Bobo travel to the town of Chedron with the intention of robbing the local bank whose owner, De Koven, is trying to oust all ranchers in the area by the simple expedient of foreclosing on the mortgages his bank holds on their land.

title: Fyre Fraud
description: FYRE FRAUD is a true-crime comedy exploring a failed music festival turned internet meme at the nexus of social media influence, late-stage capitalism, and morality in the post-truth era.

title: G-Loc
