description: Spence Cutler never felt empathy or guilt. However, a fateful encounter with a new drug is about to give him a dose of too much reality, and he takes a mind-bending trip down the psychedelic highway of consciousness to come face to face with his own morality and his own twisted soul.

title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
description: When their family homes are threatened by a local land developer, a group of youngsters set out to locate the mysterious James brothers' treasure, a legend that may just save Ford county and allow them to keep their family homes forever.

title: Louder Than Words
description: After the unexpected death of their daughter, a couple work to build a state of the art children's hospital where families are welcomed into the healing process.

title: Louie
description: Have you ever dreamed of exploring an island or travelling to the moon? Do you yearn to race cars or talk to friendly bears? No problem! Everything is possible with Louie! With his and Yoko´s help, you´ll learn how to draw while having fun!

title: Love & Other Drugs
description: A womanizing Viagra salesman with no sense of direction or responsibility falls in love with a free-spirited woman.

title: Love & Where to Find It
description: Two local coffee shop business owners despise each other in real life, but fall in love while unknowingly sending each other messages via a dating app on their friends’ behalf.

title: Love and Honor
description: While fighting in Vietnam, Dalton hears his girlfriend back home has dumped him. He has a week's leave coming up so decides to fly to get her back. AWOL from the war zone, he has seven days to get back to the US, change his girlfriend's mind and make it back to Vietnam without anyone noticing.

title: Love at Sunset Terrace
description: Tired of her fast-paced life in the city, Sophie Carter travels to a small seaside town to disconnect and self-reflect, staying at an Airbnb run by a widowed father of a young girl.

title: Love Flower
description: Joshua is in a rut that is peaking with one of those bad days where things can't possibly get any worse in every single aspect of his life. Until his old pal Bucky shows up with even more bad news.

title: Love In Wolf Creek
description: On the verge of losing her wildlife refuge, Sam, along with the town's handsome newcomer, Austin, risk it all to save an injured white wolf.

title: Love is a Piece of Cake
description: Jessie Dale is a third generation baker who loves her cake shop more than anything in the world. When developers threaten to buy her building and force her out, she must do all she can to save her bakery, all while juggling a blossoming romance with her client's brother.

title: Love is Strange
description: Ben (John Lithgow) and George (Alfred Molina) finally tie the knot after living together for 40 years. But when George is fired from his job and they're unable to pay rent, the pair are forced to temporarily live apart.

title: Love on Harbor Island
description: When Seattle interior designer Lily Summers returns to her hometown to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast, she meets Marcus, the handsome seaplane pilot whose life’s work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is.

title: Love Revolution
description: Gong Ju Young is a 17-year-old high school student who thinks he has found love at school when he falls in for Wang Ja Rim at first sight. But winning her heart won’t be easy. Persistence is the key, Gong Ju Young thinks – and, over time, Wang Ja Rim starts to open up to her classmate.

title: Love Sarah
description: Three generations of women, led by Mimi will need to overcome grief, doubts and differences to honour the memory of their beloved Sarah, while embarking on a journey to establish a new bakery in Notting Hill, a place filled with love, hope and colourful pastries from all over the world.

title: Love The One You Love
description: Set in Cape Town, four star-crossed characters discover that their romantic relationships are part of a bizarre conspiracy to keep them in – or out – of love. Entirely improvised and original, this debut hails a new generation of South African cinema.

title: Love Type D
description: How can someone love you yesterday and not today? Shortly after her boyfriend sends his 12-year-old brother (Wilbur) to break the news that she's dumped, Frankie Browne (27) discovers that she has a loser in love gene. Every man she goes out with will inevitably break up with her.

title: Love's Second Chance
description: Passionate fashion stylist Rose is living her best life in NYC when she suddenly inherits her grandmother’s vintage dress shop and must return to her small hometown. There, she runs into her charming high school crush Cole Murphey, who helps her renovate the store.

title: Love, Courage and the Battle of Bushy Run
description: Colonel Henry Bouquet, with a ragtag group of British soldiers, Scottish Highlanders and American volunteers, was tasked with trying to save the hundreds of men, women and children facing certain death - or worse - in Fort Pitt.

title: Love, Rosie
description: Rosie and Alex have been best friends since age six. As they dream of travelling the world, they decide to leave their small British town for Boston together to attend university. But fate has other plans...

title: Loveless
description: Zhenya and Boris are going through a vicious divorce marked by resentment, frustration and recriminations. Already embarking on new lives, each with a new partner, they are impatient to start again, to turn the page - even if it means threatening to abandon their 12-year-old son Alyosha.

title: Loving Vincent
description: Vincent Willem van Gogh is undoubtedly one of the most famous and influential figures in the history of Western art. Yet during his lifetime Vincent struggled with poverty and depression, dying at only 37 years old.

title: Lust For Love
description: Astor's happy tenacity spoils his one chance at love with his lifelong crush Mila. Convinced he needs more experience with women to win her back, he engages her ex-best friend Cali to teach him how to woo women.

title: Luxor
description: When British aid worker Hana returns to the ancient city of Luxor, she comes across Sultan, a talented archeologist and former lover. As she wanders, haunted by the familiar place, she struggles to reconcile the choices of the past with the uncertainty of the present.

title: Lying and Stealing
description: Ivan, a successful art thief, and Elyse, an actress and con-woman, team up to pull off a heist which won't make them rich, but will set them free.

title: Lyvia's House
description: When a beautiful artist goes missing, a young journalist uncovers a horrifying reality. Inspired by true events.

title: Léa & I
description: Two best friends Léa and Camille decide to travel around Latin America to find a cure to Léa’s genetic illness, cystic fibrosis.

title: Macabre
description: A middle-aged woman, traumatized from the death of her adulterous lover, moves into a room at a New Orleans boarding house where the blind landlord becomes suspicious to her activities of continuing her affair with her dead lover.

title: Mad Heidi
description: Mountain girl Heidi is back with a vengeance, fighting a cheese-fuelled dictator in this action-packed adventure comedy.

title: Mad ship
description: A poor young Scandinavian immigrant couple winds up in Canada in search of prosperity, but the hardship of the Great Depression takes a toll in a way they never feared when they went in search of the dream.

title: Madalena
description: A broken body in a white dress, lying lifeless in a swaying soya field. The image of this motionless body lends an extra charge to everything that follows. Marcheti follows three protagonists in turn. They don't know one another, but are all in some way connected through Madalena.

title: Madame
description: The relationship between grandson and grandmother is always powerful, enigmatic. Filmmaker Stéphane Riethauser undertakes an essay on identity, gender and sexuality hand in hand with his grandmother Caroline.

title: Made for You, with Love
description: The owner of a second hand wedding dress business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she’s afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

title: Made In America
description: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV; and worse than that, he’s white.

title: Mafia Inc
description: A violent crime thriller based on Canada's most infamous mafia family. The Gamaches, father and son tailors, have been dressing the Mafia family Paternò for three generations. Vince Gamache works on behalf of Frank, the godfather, with his eldest son Giaco.

title: Magazine Dreams
description: Killian Maddox is consumed by his dream of becoming a world famous bodybuilder and one day gracing the cover of fitness magazines.

title: Magic Beyond Words
description: An inspiring look at JK Rowling's rise to become one of the most influential writers-from her humble beginnings, as an imaginative young girl and awkward teenager, to the loss of her mother and the genesis of the Harry Potter phenomenon.

title: Maja Ma
description: Pallavi Patel is the quintessential, middle aged, devoted housewife who is equally famous for her dance as she is for her cooking. But what happens when a rumor about her threatens to disrupt her middle-class family’s ethos on the eve of her son Tejas’ engagement to a rich, non-resident Indian girl?

title: Make the Sign of the Cross, Stranger
description: A bounty hunter wants to catch the Bandit Carson because he has a lot of people in his gang who are worth a lot of money.

title: Make Up Stars
description: Makeup contest series presented by the dazzling Pilar Rubio. Eight contestants compete armed with gloss, shadows and blush, judged by MUA David Molina and designer and influencer Camila Redondo.

title: Making a Killing
description: Three morticians get caught in a web of greed and deceit involving buried treasure and a tangled love affair, in this modern-day crime mystery that is based on a true story.

title: Making a Model with Yolanda Hadid
description: Yolanda Hadid and her trusted team of experts will put aspiring teen models and their "momagers" through an intensive eight-week training program focused on the physical, mental, and emotional wellness that it takes to build a sustainable brand.

title: Malicious
description: The McCabe family weekend getaway is turned upside down when a mysterious stranger knocks on their door.

title: Mallory Must Not Die!
description: Retired Colonel Harper wishes to retire to his ranch, but the malicious Bart Ambler also has an interest in the property.

title: MaMa
description: In the aftermath of a tragedy a woman, Magda, reacts with a surge of newfound life that engulfs her circle of family and friends.

title: Management
description: A traveling art saleswoman (Jennifer Aniston) tries to shake off a flaky motel manager who falls for her and won't leave her alone.

title: Mandibles
description: Two simple-minded friends discover a giant fly in the trunk of a car and decide to domesticate it to earn money with it.

title: Manhattan Night
description: Academy Award winner Adrien Brody (Houdini) stars as a New York tabloid writer drawn into a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a seductive killer.

title: Maniac
description: The terrifying story of a lone serial killer who stalks women before scalping them to add to his collection of mannequins.

title: Manifesto
description: "Manifesto" pays homage to the moving tradition and literary beauty of artistic manifestos, ultimately questioning the role of the artist in society today.

title: Mantervention
description: Convinced romance is dead, a heart-broken man turns to his best-friend who plans an unorthodox 'Mantervention'.

title: Mapplethorpe
description: Matt Smith stars in this shocking biopic chronicling the journey of the infamous 'bad boy' photographer, Robert Mapplethorpe. Following him as an artist growing up in 1950's Queens, New York.

title: Maps to the Stars
description: Led by the child-star Benjie, we witness the convoluted world of selfish celebrities and their minions, all of whom are about to be manipulated by Agatha, Benjie’s tormented sister.

title: Marcus
description: Patrick Savey plunges us into Marcus’s world, capturing the New York roots of the legendary bass player, following his path like the pebbles of Tom Thumb, as he meets masters of Jazz.

title: Marcus
description: Marcus has a checkered past, but unexpected news brings an opportunity for him to right old wrongs and make amends. Marcus will have to face the consequences and overcome the greatest obstacle of all in order to find happiness: Himself.

title: Mark, Mary & Some Other People
description: Newlyweds, reluctantly decide to give ethical non-monogamy a try as their lives get increasingly complicated.

title: Marrying Millions
description: Marrying Millions follows six couples who are deeply in love and hoping to marry, but come from completely different worlds. Regular people are whisked off their feet and plunged into a high-end life of riches

title: Mary and The Witch's Flower
description: Young Mary follows a mysterious cat into the nearby forest and discovers an old broomstick and the strange Fly-by-Night flower, a rare plant that blossoms once every seven years. Together, the flower and the broomstick whisk Mary above the clouds, and far away to Endor College, a school of magic...

title: Mary Shelley
description: The tempestuous romance that inspired one of Gothic literature’s most influential works is brought to life in Mary Shelley, a luscious and moving period drama starring Elle Fanning and directed by Haifaa al-Mansour (Wadjda).

title: Massacre At Grand Canyon
description: After a search for his father's killers, Mitchum returns home only to find himself involved in a bloody land dispute.

title: Master Gardener
description: When a meticulous horticulturist takes on a troubled apprentice his life is thrown into chaos and dark secrets from his past emerge.

title: Masterminds
description: David Ghantt is a simple man stuck in a monotonous life. Every day he drives an armored car, transporting millions with no escape in sight. The only bit of excitement is his crush Kelly Campbell, who lures him into the scheme of a lifetime.

title: Match
description: As a Juilliard professor is interviewed by a woman and her husband for her dissertation on the history of dance in 1960s New York City, it becomes increasingly clear that the couple want more than just academic insight from the professor.

title: Matchday
description: Discover what happens inside the FC Barcelona dressing room, experience how the matches are lived, enjoy the victories with the team, suffer the defeats from within, share free time with the players...

title: Matter of Respect
description: After their grandfather’s death, the Kılıç family moves to Istanbul to start anew. But when Hasan’s dream jewelry store is robbed before opening, tragedy strikes and he takes his life.

title: Matthews
description: Considered by many to be one of the greatest athletes of all time, Sir Stanley Matthews’ footballing skill, sportsmanship and pioneering spirit placed him light years ahead of his time.

title: Max Winslow and the House of Secrets
description: Five teens are invited to the home of an eccentric billionaire to compete in a game to win his mansion. The night takes a dark turn when they become trapped in the house and are forced to face off against each other and an evil AI entity who controls everything in the house including their fate.

title: Maximum Conviction
description: Hollywood's toughest heroes, action legend Steven Seagal and iconic wrestler 'Stone Cold' Steve Austin, join forces in this explosive thriller. Tom Steele, an operations genius, and Manning, a weapons expert, work for an elite black-ops security force.

title: Maximum Security
description: Jack (Dolph Lundgren Aquaman / Creed 2) is a former CIA contractor who now oversees a team of elite thieves. One night in a small Mexican town, they flawlessly execute an intricate heist. On the way to a lucrative payout the Mexican authorities suddenly apprehend them.

title: Maximum Truth
description: Comedy following political grifter Rick Klingman as he aims to take down a rival congressional candidate.

title: May the Best House Win
description: As the saying goes, “home is where the heart is”, but for four house-proud strangers it’s much more than this; it’s also the chance to compete in the ultimate contest May The Best House Win.

title: Maya the Bee
description: Maya is a busy little bee, ready to leave her hive and live in the meadow, free like a bee. The world is just too big and too fascinating to remain confined to the restricted life of the hive.

title: Maya the Bee: The Golden Orb
description: When a bored Maya and Willi bust out of winter lockdown early, they are catapulted headfirst into a top secret mission! Entrusted with the care of a sacred seed, Maya and Willi team up with their old pal's Arnie and Barnie to deliver the seed to its new home atop the mysterious Bonsai Mountain.

title: Mañana Es Hoy
description: Summer of 1991. The Gaspar family is on holiday, but after arguing with her father, Lulu decides to run away with her boyfriend. While on a paddleboat ride, the rest of the family is hit by a violent storm.

title: McVeigh
description: A psychological thriller exploring the deadliest act of domestic terrorism in U.S. history orchestrated by army veteran Timothy McVeigh.

title: Me The People: A Populist Handbook
description: Me The People explores how wedge politics on key divisive issues, is giving rise to a new kind of populist leader.

title: Me You Madness
description: Catherine Black is a ruthlessly ambitious business woman who happens to also be gorgeous. She lives a life of luxury: architectural dream house in Malibu, exclusive designer fashions, fast cars and exquisite jewelry. She has no need for a man except to satisfy her natural killer instinct, literally.

title: Me, Myself and Di
description: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance.

title: Measure of Revenge (Leave Not One Alive)
description: When her son's death is ruled as an accidental overdose, a suspicious Lillian decides to take matters into her own hands. On a quest for answers, she strikes up an unlikely alliance with her son's drug dealer, Taz, setting in motion a bloody warpath to uncover the truth.

title: Medical Detectives
description: Forensic experts and investigators piece together clues and evidence to solve the most puzzling criminal cases in this true-crime docuseries.

title: Medici
description: In 15th-century Renaissance Florence, the visionary Medici dynasty flexes its power in politics and the arts, risking its rivals' lethal opposition. Starring Richard Madden, Dustin Hoffman and more.

title: Meet Dave
description: Seeking a way to save their doomed world, a crew of tiny, human-looking aliens arrives on Earth in the perfect disguise--a spaceship shaped like an ordinary man.

title: Meet Me in New York
description: Kelly is a young, creative, ambitious events planner in New York City and quickly gaining a reputation as one of the best in the business. But when Joe, an influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's 10th birthday party, Kelly quickly realizes that she may have just met her match.

title: Meet The Patels
description: In this real-life "My Big Fat Greek Wedding," Indian-American actor Ravi Patel embarks on a quest to find a wife and make his family happy.

title: Meet the Spartans
description: From the creators of Date Movie comes this tongue-in-cheek parody of the sword-and-sandal epics, dubbed MEET THE SPARTANS.

title: Mega Shark vs Crocosaurus
description: A megalodon battles with a crocosaurus causing massive destruction. The US Army has to try and destroy the havoc creating monsters.

title: Mega Shark vs Giant Octopus
description: The California coast is terrorized by two enormous prehistoric sea creatures as they battle each other for supremacy of the sea.

title: Mega Shark vs Kolossus
description: In search of a new energy source, Russia accidentally reawakens the Kolossus - a giant robot doomsday device from the Cold War. At the same time, a new Mega Shark appears, threatening global security.

title: Mega Shark vs Mecha Shark
description: A new mega shark threatens to destroy humanity. The government creates an exact robotic copy of the shark, either equal to or greater than the original. Now they must fight to the death while people and whole cities get in the way.

title: Megacities
description: Megacities is a documentary about the slums of four different metropolitan cities: Bombay, Mexico City, Moscow and New York. The film is a tale in twelve episodes about people struggling to survive with resourcefulness, humor, and dignity.

title: Melrose
description: A struggling actor on the outskirts of Hollywood takes a sketchy day job on Melrose Avenue, and uncovers the dark reality of living in Hollywood in the twenty-first century.

title: Men Of War
description: Nick Gunar is a burnt-out former mercenary who is having a difficult time adjusting to civilian life. He’s hired by the Nitro Mine Corporation to strong-arm the natives of a South China Sea island into giving up their rights to its mineral resources.

title: Merantau
description: From Gareth Evans, director of the Raid I & II comes 'Merantau'. Living the simple life of a young man in rural west Sumatra, Yuda heads to Jakarta to undergo trial of 'Merantau'. Yuda is soon plummeted into the violent world of human trafficking where he is forced to go on the run.

title: MessiCirque
description: We will see the formative moments, the creative and artistic development, Messi´s participation with the project, training, rehearsals and the "Messi10 Challenge LaLiga".

title: Mia and Me: The Hero of Centopia
description: When Mia discovers that her magical gem is part of a prophecy, she is transported through the power of an ancient book into the land of Centopia, a world of wonder now under threat from a poisonous and monstrous enemy known as Toxor.

title: Miami Supercops
description: Doug and Steve have remained friends, even after Steve left the FBI. But reuniting them will be Garret, a dangerous ex-con whose case the two cops had worked on together.

title: Mid90s
description: Written and directed by Jonah Hill, Mid90s follows Stevie, a thirteen-year-old in 90s-era LA who spends his summer navigating between his troubled home life and a group of new friends that he meets at a Motor Avenue skate shop.

title: Middle of Nowhere
description: With her husband in prison, life seems bleak for Ruby, but a chance encounter puts her back on a journey towards a future she thought was lost.

title: Mig Said
description: Mig Said is a beautiful animated collection of poetic ales about discovering the world. Asking and answering questions like “What can a white bear have in common with a black bear?” and “Do we only make friends with people similar to ourselves?”

title: Mile 22
description: In a visceral modern thriller from the director of Lone Survivor, Mark Wahlberg stars as James Silva, an operative of the CIA’s most highly-prized and least-understood unit.

title: Miliki Family
description: Baby Miliki explores the world with his adventure companion, Grandad Miliki, who adds musical fun to the most mundane situations.

title: Million Pound Movers
description: With the number of millionaire homeowners rising, the high-end removals industry in the UK is booming. Million Pound Movers goes behind closed doors to meet the wealthy clients moving priceless objects, plus the firms tasked with completing the job.

title: Mimicus
description: Han Yu Seong (Yoo Young Jae) is a talented but reserved student at Daehan Performing Arts High School, often misunderstood as aloof. When rumors spread that he's copying Ji Su Bin's (Kim Yoon Woo) style, tensions rise as both students harbor hidden secrets.

title: Minamata
description: Photojournalist W. Eugene Smith (Johnny Depp) travels to a city ravaged by mercury poisoning, the result of decades of gross corporate negligence.

title: Mind Wave
description: A cybersecurity expert is wrongfully accused of a devastating attack on China's internet. As he fights to clear his name, his wife mysteriously vanishes, leaving behind a trail of cryptic clues that point to a deeper conspiracy.

title: Mini's First Time
description: A rebellious girl hooks up with an escort agency, where her stepfather is a client.

title: Miracle That We Met
description: Song Hyeon Cheol (Kim Myung Min) is a financial industry hotshot. To outsiders, his kindly wife Seon Hye Jin (Kim Hyeon Joo) seems like the luckiest woman alive. But that sadly isn’t the case.

title: Miracles: The Canton Godfather
description: A country boy becomes the head of a gang through the purchase of some lucky roses from an old lady. He and a singer at the gang's nightclub try to do a good deed for the old lady when her daughter comes to visit.

title: Mirrors
description: From the director of The Hills Have Eyes comes the terrifying story of troubled ex-cop who must save his family from an unspeakable evil that is using mirrors as a gateway into their home.

title: Misery Loves Comedy
description: A star-studded cast including Tom Hanks, Matthew Perry, Jon Favreau, Whoopi Goldberg, Lisa Kudrow, Steve Coogan, Jimmy Fallon and many more, dig into their earliest comic experiences, most epic fails and tell unforgettable anecdotes to reveal a performer's deep  desire to connect with audiences.

title: Miss Juneteenth
description: Turquoise, a former beauty queen turned hardworking single mother, prepares her rebellious teenage daughter for the Miss Juneteenth pageant, hoping to keep her from repeating the same mistakes in life that she did.

title: Miss Meadows
description: A story centered on a proper elementary school teacher who moonlights as a vigilante.

title: Miss Sloane
description: Elizabeth Sloane (Jessica Chastain – Zero Dark Thirty) is the most sought-after, formidable and ruthless lobbyist in D.C.

title: Missing Persons
description: Follows a special police department which deals with cases where people have disappeared.

title: Mississippi Grind
description: Gerry (Ben Mendelsohn) is a talented but struggling poker player, about to be swallowed up by his unshakable gambling habit, when his luck begins to change after he meets the young, charismatic Curtis (Ryan Reynolds).

title: Mob Town
description: In early 1957, Sgt. Ed Croswell (David Arquette - 'Scream'), a police officer in the small town of Apalachin, New York, had stopped Carmine Gilante (Gino Cafarelli - 'The Irishman'), an accused member of a Mafioso group led by Joe Barbara.

title: Molang
description: Molang is an affectionate, humorous look at the relationship between an eccentric, joyful, and enthusiastic rabbit, and a shy, discreet, and emotional little chick. The series explores Molang and Piu Piu’s everyday life with warmth and humor.

title: Mommy
description: Xavier Dolan’s stunning tale of a mother battling to raise her tearaway teenage son.

title: Monk Little Dog
description: Monk is a jovial little dog who obstinately tries his best but always fails! When thins aren’t working out for Monk, catastrophes follow. Things can get totally out of control real fast! Director/creator: Sungjae Kim, Natalys Raut Sieuzac, Suhoon Kim

title: Monkey Up
description: The all-new family comedy about a talking capuchin monkey seeking to gain fame and fortune as a movie star, but instead finds what’s most important, a family.

title: Monster
description: Based on the life of Aileen Wuornos, a Daytona Beach prostitute who became a serial killer.

title: Monster High Webisodes: Volume 1 (part 1)
description: Monster High students come from all walks of life. From ghosts and werewolves to vampires and sea monsters (and more!), everyone is welcome at Monster High.

title: Monster High Webisodes: Volume 1 (Part 2)
description: Monster High students come from all walks of life. From ghosts and werewolves to vampires and sea monsters (and more!), everyone is welcome at Monster High.

title: Monster High: 13 Wishes
description: It’s a new school year at Monster High, and the little sister of Clawdeen Wolf, Howleen, is determined to be more fangtastic than ever. Her dream of popularity turns out to be easier than anyone imagined when she stumbles upon a genie named Gigi Grant who grants her not 3, but 13 wishes!

title: Monster High: Adventures of the Ghoul Squad
description: Get ready for a voltageous time! The ghouls are back like you’ve never seen them before in this action-packed adventure!

title: Monster High: Boo York, Boo York
description: It’s fright lights, big city when the Monster High™ ghouls head to Boo York! Cleo de Nile™ is invited to attend a fancy gala celebrating the return of a magical comet and, of course, she brings along her beast friends.

title: Monster High: Escape from Skull Shores
description: It's officially spring break at Monster High! Lagoona Blue takes her gilfriends across the sea to the Great Barrier Reef, but they are shipwrecked and end up on a mysterious skull shaped island...

title: Monster High: Freaky Fusion
description: When the ghouls travel back in time to learn about Frankie's scaritage, a lab accident fuses 8 ghouls into 4 new monsters!...

title: Monster High: Friday Night Frights
description: School spirit couldn't be higher as Monster High is racing toward the championship in the most ghoultastic sport ever, Skulltimate Roller Maze! But when the competing team at Granite City High start to play dirty, the Ghoulfriends have to join the team and save the day and the championship!

title: Monster High: Fright On!
description: Frankie Stein, Clawdeen Wolf, Draculaura and their ghoulfriends must restore the imperfectly perfect harmony of Monster High when a normie tries to tear them apart.

title: Monster High: Frights, Camera, Action!
description: When Draculaura™ is led to believe she's the rightful heir to the vampire throne, she and her best ghoulfriends are whisked away to Transylvania for a royal coronation to die for. But they soon discover the hunt for the queen is not over yet...

title: Monster High: Ghouls Rule!
description: Monster High: Ghouls Rule unearths an old conflict between "Normies" and monsters - and things are about to get scary! For years  students at Monster High were warned that Halloween was a night to stay inside and avoid conflict at all costs.

title: Monster High: Great Scarrier Reef
description: When the ghouls get pulled into the school pool, they find themselves transported to a world of coral and florals—a wild underwater wonderland! But Lagoona is not there to see the sights— she’s on mission of the heart, as she realizes she has come home!

title: Monster High: Haunted
description: Lurk what's waiting for the Monster High ghouls when they bring their killer fashion to the howlways of the spooktacular Haunted High!

title: Monster High: New Ghoul in School
description: 'New Ghoul at School'  follows newcomer Frankie Stein from her first day at the school and shows how she becomes one of the most popular ghouls around.

title: Monster High: Scaris, City of Frights
description: When Clawdeen Wolf gets the chance to apprentice for the legendary fashion designer Madame Ghostier, she and her best ghoul friends immediately pack their bags and hop on a plane to beautiful Scaris, France.

title: Monster High: The Howliday Special
description: Draculaura has a fright idea when her dad lectures her class on human holidays!

title: Monster High: Welcome to Monster High
description: MONSTERS once lived in hiding—even from each other—because they were afraid they would be in danger if humans knew they existed. But Draculaura, the daughter of Dracula, along with her best ghoulfriends, dreamt of a school where everyone was welcome and accepted for who they are.

title: Monster High: Why Do Ghouls Fall In Love
description: As the epic Sweet 1600th of Draculara™ approaches, she’s got two crush-worthy guys out to steal her heart (literally) before the big event in this freaky fabulous movie!

title: Monster High:Electrified
description: When Clawdeen dreams of opening a salon made for monsters and normies, Frankie has the perfect place – an abandoned power station outside town. But the idea sparks negative voltage when Moanica plots to ruin the whole thing, and replace the celebration with something a little more…

title: Monsters
description: Six years ago NASA discovered the possibility of alien life within our solar system. A probe was launched to collect samples, but crashed upon re-entry over Central America. Soon after, new life forms began to appear and half of Mexico was quarantined as an infected zone.

title: Monsters and Men
description: When young father Manny witnesses the police shooting of an unarmed black man, the tight-knit community of Bed-Stuy is pushed to the brink in Reinaldo.

title: Monte Carlo
description: Grace (Selena Gomez) is an ordinary girl who becomes an accidental princess when a family summer trip to Paris turns into the fantasy of a lifetime. Living like royalty, Grace, along with her two best friends, discovers who she really is – by assuming another person’s identity.

title: Moon Students
description: After Lita's boyfriend Antonio gets into an unseen altercation he is suspended and refuses to discuss what happened.

title: Moonstruck
description: In this classic romantic comedy, a Brooklyn widow (Cher) is ready to get married again. Only this time, she plans on doing it right, even if she has to say “yes” to a man she doesn’t really love.

title: Mope
description: 'Boogie Nights' meets 'The Disaster Artist', in this darkly humorous and shocking true crime story.

title: Mosley
description: To save his family, Mosley, must embark on an epic journey to find the legendary Uprights... but what he unexpectedly finds will unlock a secret revealing his true nature. With large and layered themes, Mosley tells a timeless adventurous tale of family, love and hope!

title: Most Horrible Things
description: Six strangers are invited to a dinner party by a charming and enigmatic host, lured by the promise of substantial financial reward if they last the whole evening. However, all is not what it seems.

title: Mother and Child
description: Naomi Watts, Annette Bening , Kerry Washington, Jimmy Smits and Samuel L. Jackson star in a moving story of three women and the power of the unbreakable bond between mother and child.

title: Mother Father Sister Brother Frank
description: A suburban family plots murder when an uncle crashes Sunday dinner with a nasty surprise.

title: Mother's Day
description: There are only a few days left before the Mother’s Day, as several families have to come to terms with how they’ll be spending the big day.

title: Motherland
description: In an alternate society where the state frees parents from the burden of raising children, a rule enforcer learns a shocking truth that sparks her rebellion.

title: Motherland - Honour & Valour
description: A journey of a man discovering himself, finding love and fighting for his motherland. Can he hold the fort on all three gates?

title: Mouk
description: Mouk and Chavapa are two globe-trotters: they travel around the world riding their bikes! From Tokyo to New York, from Australia to Madagascar and through Greece, these two friends meet inhabitants from all over the planet…

title: Mr Doom - Behind the 8 ball
description: Jack and Charlie are an unlikely pair on a dangerous path to self destruction in a world of their own design. Both struggling to keep up a bygone lifestyle that revolves around a green felt table with six pockets and sixteen balls.

title: Mr. Calzaghe
description: The extraordinary life and career of Welsh-Italian Boxer, Joe Calzaghe, and his father and trainer, Enzo.

title: Mr. Morgan's Last Love
description: From the day Pauline (Clemence Poésy) lends him a helping hand on the bus, the stubborn and weary Matthew Morgan (Sir Michael Caine) stumbles back to happiness.

title: Ms. White Light
description: The story of Lex, a woman who counsels terminally ill clients. While proving uniquely talented in her ability to connect with the dying, Lex is at a total loss when it comes to dealing with everyone else. When Valerie refuses to play by Lex's rules, Lex is forced to question her own decisions.

title: Murder and Cocktails
description: When their next-door neighbor is murdered, there’s an entire floor of suspects. To find the killer, a married couple has the other residents over to probe for clues over cocktails. When another body is found, no one can be trusted.

title: Murder Company
description: In the midst of the D-Day invasion, a group of US soldiers are given orders to smuggle a member of the French resistance behind enemy lines to assassinate a high-value Nazi target.

title: Murder in the Vineyard
description: Life is amazing for Emma and her teenage daughter Beatrice when they move from the big city to an idyllic small town, but then Beatrice is hazed at a party one night by mysterious bullies. Eager to protect her daughter, Emma sets out to find who the culprit is, but her digging soon turns deadly…

title: Murder Obsession
description: Michael is an actor who decides to take a break with his girlfriend Deborah. He then returns to his mother’s house, a large villa in which a tragedy had occurred a few years earlier, namely the murder of his father, for which he was accused. Mother Glenda and the creepy butler Oliver welcome them.

title: Mutant X
description: A fugitive geneticist and four of his "creations" search for others of their kind while attempting to stay a step ahead of a morally ambiguous government agent.

title: Mutiny at Fort Sharpe
description: The French army and revolutionaries face off on the Mexican border. An overseas contingent is forced to take refuge in an American fort, and this is the beginning of a strange alliance. The Southerners from Texas in fact make a pact with the Dragoons, who support Maximilian against the Indians.

title: MVP II: Most Vertical Primate
description: After being booted from his hockey team, Jack hits the road and meets Ben, a skateboarder with big dreams. Turns out Jack also has some impressive skater skills and the two set out on an hilarious cross-country skate tour!

title: MVP: Most Valuable Primate
description: Jack, a chimpanzee who recently escaped from an experimental lab, finds his way onto the ice at a junior hockey practice. Steven and his teammates realize the chimp has a natural talent for the game and he officially joins the team. As they win game after game, Jack becomes a minor celebrity.

title: MXP: Most Xtreme Primate
description: Jack’s back and he’s taking his skills in the half-pipe to the frosty peaks of Colorado. Jack teams up with two snowboarding brothers and their dad to turn the whole snowboarding world on its head! Jack’s skills take him to where no chimp has ever gone before and it’s sure to be a wild ride.

title: My All American
description: Freddie Steinmark, an underdog on the gridiron, faces the toughest challenge of his life after leading his team to a championship season.

title: My Awkward Sexual Adventure
description: In this laugh out loud romantic-comedy, uptight accountant Jordan Abrams proposes to his long-term girlfriend, pushing her to reveal the painful truth: he’s terrible in bed.

title: My Christmas Fiancé
description: A part-time student at a resort restaurant in beautiful Italy is hired by her boss to pose as his fiancée for the holidays, so he can avoid getting married.

title: My Christmas Pony
description: Juliet leaves the city to join her mother Karen on a visit to her late grandfather's struggling ranch in the country. At the ranch, Juliet meets her grandfather's horse Rodeo and young cowboy called Monty.

title: My Days of Mercy
description: A powerful and heart-wrenching tale of finding love in the least-likely of places. Academy Award nominee Elliot Page ('Inception', 'The Umbrella Academy') and Kate Mara (TV's 'House of Cards') star in the highly compelling and moving romantic drama, 'My Days of Mercy'.

title: My Decision, by Andrés Iniesta
description: A revealing documentary following the legendary midfielder, Andrés Iniesta, as he faces a crucial decision after a career-threatening injury.

title: My Ex-Ex
description: When Mary's boyfriend Ted invites her out to a fancy restaurant, she's convinced he's going to pop the question. But instead of getting hitched, Mary gets dumped.

title: My Father's Secrets
description: An intimate, thought-provoking film that focuses on a family's journey to reconciliation after facing the trauma of the Holocaust.

title: My Favorite Girlfriend
description: Conrad's meticulously organized lifestyle is upended when he meets Molly, an enigmatic woman who seems to share headspace with multiple other women with distinct identities - each with traits that Conrad finds lovable.

title: My First Barbie: Happy DreamDay
description: Sing along with Barbie, Barbie, Teresa, and Renee in this musical adventure as they plan the biggest surprise birthday party ever for Barbie’s sister, Chelsea. “Bigger than JUST a birthday, we have to plan a DREAMDAY!”

title: My name is Bernadette
description: Lourdes, February 11, 1858, Bernadette then aged 14 will have an encounter that will turn her life, her city and the whole world upside down.

title: My New York Year
description: 1990s, New York City: A recent grad and aspiring writer lands a job as assistant to renowned writer J.D. Salinger’s literary agent.

title: My Policeman
description: A tale of forbidden romance and changing social conventions, "My Policeman" follows the relationships between three people — policeman Tom, teacher Marion and museum curator Patrick — and their emotional and complex journey that spans decades.

title: My Super Ex-Girlfriend
description: A man who dumps his long-time girlfriend discovers his ex is a superhero, and she’s out for revenge.

title: My Teenage Wedding
description: Everyone thinks they’re too young to get married, but they don’t care! Convinced that their love is the forever kind, these teens will stop at nothing to walk down the aisle.

title: Mysterious Circumstance: The Death of Meriwether Lewis
description: After explorer Meriwether Lewis suffers an untimely death, a messenger from the President is sent to investigate. A tense encounter with the only witness begins to unravel the mystery. Was it suicide, an accident, murder, or conspiracy?

title: Mythica: The Darkspore
description: Marek and her company must go on a journey and prevent Szorlok from obtaining all the shards of the Darkspore, or all will be lost.

title: Naked Beauty
description: This beautiful film ventures to take a closer look at the naked body and the fragile spirit that lies within it. The film approaches people as sculptures, presenting them in all their glory, their sadness, their longing.

title: Naked Fashion
description: You’ve never seen a red carpet takedown like this before! Join the opinionated and outspoken panelists of Naked Fashion as they literally strip the worst dressed celebrities of their fashion crimes…

title: Native
description: A signal from the other side of the universe is received by a hive-like society. Two scientists, Cane and Eva, are chosen to leave home and journey many light years to find and colonise the distant world that sent this transmission.

title: Naughty
description: In order to prevent the construction of a skyscraper in an urban forest, Elya, a young environmental activist, accepts a challenge from the mega wealthy developer: If after spending seven days with him, she doesn't fall for him, he'll stop the project.

title: Nazi Undead
description: A young American couple venture into the heartland of Germany for a romantic holiday. Things take a sinister turn when they encounter a Nazi SS Officer at an isolated farmhouse thrusting them into a vortex of horror.

title: NEDS
description: From acclaimed Director Peter Mullan comes NEDS, the story of a young man’s journey from prize winning schoolboy to knife carrying teenager.

title: Nemesis
description: Underworld kingpin John Morgan (Billy Murray) returns to London from his perfect life abroad, reigniting a feud with vengeful cop Frank Conway (Nick Moran) who is obsessed with bringing him down and setting in motion a power play with his brother (Frank Harper).

title: Neon Days
description: Jake's life is controlled by depression, anxiety, and anger issues. He starts therapy but isn't comfortable talking about the issues that matter. His therapist, Sean, treads lightly to build a relationship with Jake over several months.

title: Neurovenge
description: In the wake of a family tragedy, a strong-willed teenager and her grieving stepfather volunteer to help a mysterious tech company evaluate its new A.I. operating system.

title: Nevada Heist
description: A former MMA fighter and his brothers agree to transport $50M in illegal diamonds for a crime syndicate. After they're robbed, they have 48 hours to recover the loot or lose their kidnapped family - forcing them into a brutal fight for survival.

title: Never Die Alone
description: Adapted from a cult novel, the story charts the spectacular rise and brutal fall of a black drug dealer (DMX) as it is relayed to a young white journalist (David Arquette) posthumously through the dead hustler's diaries.

title: New Fist of Fury
description: Lung, a thief, is unwillingly hired by Lier, fiance of Chen Cen, to help her save her martial arts school from the Japanese. However, Lung must first master the martial arts to prove his worth.

title: Nicole, her Ex & the Killer
description: In order to move on with her life, a woman must face her sh*tty family, a creepy ex and a serial killer.

title: Night Harvest
description: In 1970s Tennessee, Nathan (a troubled teenager with pyrokinesis) is on the run from the cops, with his sister and her friends, until their RV breaks down and they find themselves stalked by an ancient evil from a nearby farm.

title: Night of the Serpent
description: Hernandez, commander of the garrison in a small village, joins a group of townsmen with the intention of robbing orphan Manuel of his inheritance.

title: Night of the Sharks
description: David must fight for his life against the gangsters who killed his brother for a CD filled with proof of their illegal activities. When David gets possession of the CD they go down to Mexico where David lives as a shark hunter. Who will get David first, the gangsters or the shark?

title: Night Raiders
description: Night Raiders is a relentless and thought-provoking, dystopian thriller from executive producer Taika Waititi, which stars Alex Tarrant  and Amanda Plummer.

title: Night Train
description: In this tightly crafted action thriller, a single mother struggling to survive agrees to run black market medical supplies in her legendary pick-up truck, "Night Train", with the FBI in hot pursuit.

title: Nighthawks
description: Wide-eyed Midwest transplant Stan (Chace Crawford) agrees to play wingman to his calculating and privileged roommate Chad (Kevin Zegers) as they embark upon an exploration of glittering New York nightlife, whose darkest secrets are held captive by an elite band of millennials known as Nighthawks.

title: Nightmare Beach - Welcome To Spring Break
description: The leader of a violent motorcycle gang is accused of murdering a woman. Although he declares himself innocent, he is sentenced to death. On the electric chair he swears to come back to life for revenge. In the coastal town of Spring Break, a series of unexplained murders soon ensues.

title: Nights and Weekends
description: In her directorial debut, Greta Gerwig stars as Mattie, a New York resident who over the course of a year desperately tries to navigate through the struggles of a long-distance relationship with her partner, James, who lives in Chicago.

title: Nine Bullets
description: Gypsy Moon (Lena Headey – Games of Thrones) is a novelist by day and when night falls, she dances to earn her keep.

title: Nine Lives
description: When work-obsessed real-estate mogul, Tom Brand (Kevin Spacey) suffers a magical accident that leaves him trapped inside the body of his 11-year-old daughter’s cat, he realizes he has to put his family first if he ever hopes to regain his human form.

title: Ninja
description: American born Casey has dedicated his life to studying the ancient art of Ninjutsu in Japan. Casey’s training is put to the test when his Sensei asks him to return to New York to protect the legendary Yoroi Bitsu, an armored chest that contains the weapons of the last Koga Ninja.

title: Ninja: Shadow Of A Tear
description: Scott Adkins returns as Casey Bowman, who is now  the sensei of a successful dojo, married to the beautiful Namiko, and expecting their first baby. But when Casey returns home one day to find someone has brutally killed Namiko, bereft, Casey has only one thing left to live for... Revenge.

title: Nitram
description: Nitram lives with his mother and father in suburban Australia in the Mid 1990s. He lives a life of isolation and frustration at never being able to fit in. That is until he unexpectedly finds a close friend in a reclusive heiress, Helen.

title: No Room to die
description: Brandon and Murdock must hunt down a man to collect a large bounty. But one of them plays dirty, and the other takes revenge.

title: Noah
description: Academy Award® winner Russell Crowe stars as Noah, a man chosen by God for a great task before an apocalyptic flood destroys the world.

title: Nocebo
description: A fashion designer (Eva Green) suffers from a mysterious illness that confounds her doctors and frustrates her husband (Mark Strong) - until help arrives in the form of a Filipino nanny (Chai Fonacier) who uses traditional folk healing to reveal a horrifying truth.

title: Nostalgia
description: A man with a hidden past returns home to Naples after decades away and is forced to face up to his former life in Mario Martone’s soulful paean to his hometown.

title: Not Another Happy Ending
description: When struggling publisher Tom Duval discovers his only successful author, Jane Lockhart, has writer's block, he knows he has to help.

title: Nothing But The Truth
description: Nothing but the Truth is an edge-of-your-seat political thriller starring Kate Beckinsale, Vera Farmiga and Matt Dillon. Washington DC political journalist Rachel Armstrong writes an explosive story about a government scandal in which she reveals the name of a covert CIA agent.

title: Nothing Like A Dame
description: From time to time four old friends, all extraordinary actresses, meet up in the English countryside to gossip, to remember and to laugh. For once they let the cameras in...

title: Nothing Like the Holidays
description: The far-flung members of the Rodriguez family converge at their parents' home to face what may be their last Christmas together in this heart-warming holiday comedy.

title: Nourathar
description: Through the creations of various contemporary artists, the film rehearses an inspiring exploration of the relationship between nature, art and technology.

title: Number 37
description: A Hitchcockian thriller, examining the dark criminal underworld of South Africa. Wheelchair bound and trapped in his apartment, Randal is given binoculars by his devoted girlfriend, Pam.

title: Nurse Betty
description: A unique black-comedy featuring a Golden Globe-winning performance by Renée Zellweger as Betty: a soap opera fanatic who creates her own alternate reality after witnessing the brutal murder of her husband by two hit-men (Morgan Freeman and Chris Rock).

title: Nuts Nuts Nuts
description: Nuts is an obsessed, clumsy blue squirrel. He lives with other animals ina crazy, lively, funny and sometimes absurd world. Wherever he goes, he causes disasters...

title: Odd Thomas
description: Based on the best-selling novel by Dean Koontz, Odd Thomas is not like other 20 year old boys; he has the clairvoyant ability to see dead people!

title: Odds and Evens
description: A Navy officer joins forces with his half-brother, a former gambler, to infiltrate and break up a gang of illegal bookmakers.

title: Of Gods and Warriors
description: Helle is the only child of King Asmund and Queen Alva and the one true heir to the Viking kingdom of Volsung. Yet she is unaware of her true lineage, for Helle was switched at birth with her cousin, her evil uncle Bard having convinced King Asmund that a female heir would weaken the kingdom.

title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
description: Oggy’s life in his pretty little house would be a dream if it weren’t for three nasty cockroaches bent on turning it into a living hell. It’s explosive and hilarious…it’s Oggy and the Cockroaches!

title: Old Flame
description: A college reunion spirals into violence when two former lovers reconnect and rediscover a dangerous secret.

title: On a Wing and a Prayer
description: In this extraordinary true story of faith and survival, "On A Wing and A Prayer" follows passenger Doug White’s (Dennis Quaid) harrowing journey to safely land a plane and save his entire family from insurmountable danger after their pilot dies unexpectedly mid-flight. Heather Graham also stars.

title: On Halloween
description: A journalist goes in search of the truth after a series of brutal deaths and disappearances lead back to an urban legend about a serial killing clown that has stalked the woods of Century Park for over a hundred years.

title: On the Line
description: A provocative radio host (Mel Gibson) must play a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a mysterious caller who has kidnapped his family.

title: On the Line
description: Alderney, UK. 1964. A telephone operator ends up being the pivotal piece of a drama unfurling which puts professional integrity, and relationships, to the test.

title: Ona Carbonell: Starting Over
description: In August 2020, Olympic artistic swimmer Ona Carbonell became a first time mother, an experience that reshaped her life overnight.

title: Once Upon a Lifetime
description: As a little boy struggles to cope with his difficult home life and his parents’ failing marriage, a mysterious girl suddenly appears.

title: Once You Know
description: Faced with the reality of climate change and the depletion of resources, director Emmanuel Cappellin is aware that a collapse of our industrial civilization is inevitable. But how can we continue to live with the idea that the human adventure may fail?

title: One by One
description: At the Texas/Mexico frontier, during the Civil War, Colonel Greyson was accused of embezzling $ 500,000 that he was to deliver to the Confederate command.

title: One Day After Peace
description: A mother's emotional search for reconciliation with the Palestinian sniper who killed her son in the Israeli-occupied territories.

title: One Of A Kind
description: Five transgender people reflect on their experience overcoming the binary conception of genders and tell us about their dilemmas and inspiring aspirations in life.

title: Only
description: After a mysterious plague threatens to kill all women on the planet, a couple is put to the ultimate test as they try to survive.

title: Only the Brave
description: All men are created equal… then, a few become firefighters. Only the Brave, based on the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, is the heroic story of one unit of local firefighters that through hope, determination, sacrifice, and the drive to protect families...

title: Open 24 Hours
description: FrightFest Presents a close quarters, suspense filled horror.

title: Open Water
description: 15 miles from land. One million square miles of ocean. No one knows they're missing. Daniel and Susan are about to embark on the dive of a lifetime - an underwater tour of the Caribbean. But when the couple surface, the dive boat is nowhere to be seen.

title: Open Windows
description: Nick’s a lucky guy. Tonight, he’ll be having dinner with Jill Goddard, the hottest actress on earth. She’s promoting her latest movie and he’s won the main prize in an online contest. Then he gets a call. Some guy named Chord explains that dinner has been cancelled.

title: Operation Avalanche
description: 1967: the height of the Cold War. The CIA suspects there is a Russian mole inside of NASA, sabotaging the Apollo program. They send two young agents on a mission to go undercover, posing as documentary filmmakers, there to capture NASA's race to the moon.

title: Operation Blood Hunt
description: A World War II horror, which sees occult expert, Reverend Conte, lead a team of outcast soldiers to a remote South Pacific island. Tasked with investigating the disappearance of several marine corps battalions stationed there in 1944, initial intelligence points towards the Japanese Imperial Army.

title: Operation Overlord
description: A week before storming the beaches of Normandy, two US Soldiers infiltrate an abandoned complex to rescue a prisoner of war from the clutches of the Nazi regime.

title: Operation: Endgame
description: Two rival teams of assassins. One killer day at the office. An all-star cast including Rob Corddry, Ellen Barkin, Zach Galifianakis, Ving Rhames, and Jeffrey Tambor fight to the death to be the last man standing in this hilarious action comedy!

title: Ophelia
description: A dynamic and lavish re-imagining of Shakespeare's 'Hamlet' starring Daisy Ridley, Naomi Watts and Clive Owen.

title: Oppenheimer: The Real Story (Documentary)
description: J. Robert Oppenheimer, a physics professor at the University of California, Berkeley, is best known for creating the atomic bomb during WWII as the wartime head of the Los Alamos Laboratory.

title: Origin Wars
description: CONTAINS FLASHING IMAGES: Set in the future in a time of interplanetary colonisation, Sy (Kellan Lutz), a mysterious drifter, meets Kane (Daniel MacPherson), a lieutenant working for an off-world military contractor – EXOR.

title: Orthodox
description: An Orthodox Jewish boy persecuted for his faith, turns to Boxing as a means of self defence. Now an adult, Benjamin's (Stephen Graham, This is England, Boardwalk Empire) involvement in unlicensed boxing alienates him from his North London Jewish Community.

title: Our Better World
description: The world faces many challenges today, ranging from pollution to overpopulation.  But as long as one keeps searching for solutions, all's not lost.

title: Our Dream Wedding
description: Commitment-shy Haley is as anti-marriage as it gets, but when she tries on her grandma’s ‘magical’ wedding veil, she’s transported to her future, where she and long-term boyfriend Scott are happily married with two beautiful children.

title: Out for a Kill
description: Steven Seagal ("Exit Wounds") stars as a university professor who becomes embroiled in a foiled Chinese cocaine deal. Wrongly imprisoned, he escapes to take his revenge and prove his innocence.

title: Out of Death
description: Still grieving the untimely death of her father, photojournalist Shannon Mathers spreads his ashes in the woods when she witnesses a cop shooting and killing an unarmed henchman during a drug deal. She captures the whole scene on her camera before being discovered.

title: Out Of The Furnace
description: Russell and his younger brother Rodney are living in the economically-depressed Rust Belt and have always dreamed of escaping and finding better lives.

title: Outlaws
description: An impassioned group of men and women make the decision to risk it all for family, faith, and country. This film unfolds the (hidden) true story of 1920's Cristeros War - a war by the people of Mexico against the atheistic Mexican government.

title: Outpost 11
description: Outpost 11 is the story of a group of soldiers stationed on a remote Arctic outpost. One day the warning light goes off unexpectedly and their world is plunged into chaos, as they become prey to an unknown enemy.

title: Overboard
description: Unjustly fired by a spoilt and selfish yacht owner, Kate gets payback when he falls overboard and wakes up with amnesia...

title: Overdosed
description: The troubling turmoil of the deadly American opioid crisis unfolds in the small rural town of Petersburg, West Virginia, the state hardest hit by this epidemic.

title: Panama
description: An ex-marine is hired by a defense contractor to travel to Panama to complete an arms deal. In the process he becomes involved with the U.S. invasion of Panama, and learns an important lesson about the true nature of political power.

title: Panda: Call of the Wild
description: This documentary features two giant pandas as main characters. Through their challenging experiences of being released into the wild and their growth, it encapsulates the achievements of China's giant panda conservation, showcasing the country's exemplary rescue of this globally renowned species.

title: Papaw Land
description: A troubled teenager spends the summer with his grandfather in the Ozarks, where he's free from his mother, but not her painful past.

title: Paper Year
description: Throwing caution to the wind, Franny Winters (Eve Hewson), 22, and her boyfriend Dan Delaney (Avan Jogia) take a chance on each other, and quickly get married. It may be a risk, but Franny and Dan don’t care what other people think.

title: Paradise City
description: Ryan Swan must carve his way through the Hawaiian crime world to wreak vengeance on the kingpin who murdered his father.

title: Paradise Cove
description: Midwesterners Knox and Tracey arrive in Malibu to renovate his late mother's beach house and romance to make a baby. Their plans take a twisted turn when Knox discovers Bree - a mysterious and beautiful ex-model, now a homeless woman living under the house.

title: Paradiso
description: Rafael is the projectionist of the last adult movie theater in Madrid. He believes that every day he can do his job better than the day before.

title: Parallel
description: A group of friends stumble upon a mirror that serves as a portal to a "multiverse", but soon discover that importing knowledge from the other side in order to better their lives brings increasingly dangerous consequences.

title: Paris Hilton's My New BFF Dubai
description: International hotel heiress, socialite, and reality TV star, PARIS HILTON, journeys to the United Arab Emirates to film the latest version of her hit show, MY BFF. Having already picked new BFF’s from the US and the UK, the celebutante is now headed to the glittering city of Dubai.

title: Passchendaele
description: Set during the brutal Battle of Passchendaele in WWI, a wounded Canadian soldier returns home, falls in love with a nurse, and later re-enlists to protect her brother. A powerful story of love, sacrifice, and courage amid one of history’s deadliest battles.

title: Passion
description: Christine is hungry for a promotion to the company s New York headquarters and will do whatever it takes to get there, even if it means stabbing her colleague, Isabel in the back. In retaliation, Isabel begins a passionate affair with her boss' husband.

title: Payback
description: A young stockbroker at a Mob-controlled Wall Street firm gets betrayed and sent to prison for six years. When he gets out, his quest for vengeance makes him a target of the Russian mafia.

title: Paydirt
description: A parolee (Luke Goss) teams up with his old crew determined to find a buried bag of cash stolen a decade ago from a DEA bust gone bad, while being tracked by a retired Sheriff (Val Kilmer).

title: Peacock
description: John Skillpa, a quiet bank clerk living in tiny Peacock, Nebraska, prefers to live an invisible life. This might have to do with John’s secret: he has another personality no one knows about, a woman who each morning cooks him breakfast before he starts his day. Then, in a moment, everything changes.

title: Pecos Cleans Up
description: Pinto, Paco, and Pepe arrive in a Mexican village after the gang of the criminal El Supremo kills all the inhabitants. The sole survivor of the massacre gives the three a map to Montezuma's treasure, hidden in the ruins of a temple, and the three set off in search of the priceless loot.

title: Pennywise: The Story of IT
description: Exploring the 1990 mini-series, based on Stephen King's iconic novel IT, this documentary tells a story heard by few and showcases a wealth of behind-the-scenes footage and photos seen by even fewer.

title: People I Know
description: A press agent (Al Pacino) is lead into the murky world of political conspiracy and murder when his major client becomes embroiled in a huge scandal.

title: Permanent Midnight
description: Based on an allegedly true story of TV writer Jerry Stahl with a $5000 a week job and a $6000 a week cocaine habit.

title: Personal Shopper
description: Written and directed by Olivier Assayas (Clouds of Sils Maria), Personal Shopper stars Kristen Stewart, Lars Eidinger and Anders Danielsen Lie. An ethereal and mysterious ghost story starring Kristen Stewart as a high-fashion personal shopper to the stars who is also a spiritual medium.

title: Pets
description: Join beloved house pets Bella the cat, Bagel the dog, and the always-feisty Alvin the parrot, for another fun and fact-filled afternoon in front of the TV screen watching their favorite show: Pets! When these three buddies are on the couch itʼs always a madcap and memorable time!

title: Pets 2
description: Best buddies, Bella the laid-back cat, Bagel the goofy dog, and Alvin the opinionated parrot are hanging out on their cherished couch watching the best show on TV, Pets! Bella is particularly excited because today’s episode of Pets is all about the coolest and most mysterious pet around: the cat!

title: Pets 3
description: Cute, furry, funny, these pets have it all! Join Bella the cat, Bagel the dog, and Alvin the loud-mouthed parrot and get ready for a pet-astic extravaganza! It’s time for Pets 3

title: Pets: Cat-Mania
description: Meow! Everyone’s favorite couch potato pets, Bella the cat, Bagel the dog, and Alvin the mouthy parrot break it down yet again from the comfort of their couch with a cat-themed furball extravaganza in Pets: Cat-Mania!

title: Phantom
description: The haunted Captain of a Soviet submarine holds the fate of the world in his hands. Forced to leave his family behind, he is charged with leading a covert mission cloaked in mystery.

title: Pharaoh's War
description: An ex-military man with a mysterious past leads a group of Egyptian refugees through the desert and must protect them from a group of evil mercenaries.

title: Pig Killer
description: Inspired by the true story of serial killer Robert 'Willy' Pickton, Pig Killer follows a pig farmer who, with his giant hog Balthazar and bizarre accomplices, slaughters 49 women and terrorizes Vancouver’s dark underbelly - until his gruesome crimes are uncovered.

title: Pink Rabbit
description: Martha’s daily trip from work to home and her young son becomes a nightmare as a figure dressed like a Pink Rabbit crosses her path. The Pink Rabbit, played by professional wrestler Roland Ionas Bialke forces her into three bloody quests, through three different time periods.

title: Pinocchio
description: Live-action adaptation of the beloved story of a wooden puppet named Pinocchio who magically comes to life.

title: Piper
description: Liz and her daughter Amy move to Hamelin where a dark secret in Liz's past is uncovered by the restless spirit of the Pied Piper, who seeks out those who have gotten away with a crime, and punishes them by taking away their children.

title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
description: Pacifist soldier Jim Slade, after doing two years of hard labor for refusing to use weapons, discovers that his parents have been killed and becomes a ruthless avenger.

title: Pitfighter (2013)
description: A struggling martial arts teacher must compete in an underground fight ring in order to save his brother from a crime boss and reunite with his family.

title: Planet Dune
description: A crew on a mission to rescue a marooned base on a desert planet turns deadly when the crew finds themselves hunted and attacked by the planet's apex predators: giant sand worms.

title: Planet of the Sharks
description: In the near future, glacial melting has covered ninety-eight percent of Earth's landmass. Sharks have flourished, and now dominate the planet, operating as one massive school led by a mutated alpha shark.

title: Playhouse
description: In a remote Scottish castle, an irreverent writer faces terrifying consequences when his daughter falls prey to an evil curse lurking within the walls.

title: Playing for Keeps
description: Playing For Keeps is a romantic comedy about a former soccer star who returns home to put his life back together. Looking for a way to rebuild his relationship with his son, he gets roped into coaching the boy’s soccer team.

title: Playing it Cool
description: A screenwriter working on a script for a romantic movie is having a hard time because he is a little jaded when it comes to love since his mother abandoned him when he was a boy.

title: Please Stand By
description: A young autistic woman runs away from her caregiver to boldly go and deliver her 500-page Star Trek script to a writing competition in Hollywood. On an adventure full of laughter and tears, Wendy follows the guiding spirit of Mr. Spock on her journey into the unknown.

title: Plunder Quest
description: After catching wind of valuable prohibition-era whiskey hidden on an island, Thomas Waters embarks on a quest for liquid gold and ends up on the priceless adventure of a lifetime.

title: Plus One
description: Longtime single friends Alice & Ben agree to be one another's plus ones as they power through an endless parade of hilarious and insufferable weddings

title: Poetry Sans Frontiers
description: "Poetry Sans Frontiers" is a cross-cultural exchange program launched by CGTN that breaks the language boundaries through the narration and poetry recitation of different countries and characters, employs poetry to tell the story of beautiful love, genuine friendship...

title: Point and Shoot
description: In 2006, Matt VanDyke, a timid 28-year-old with Obsessive Compulsive Disorder, left Baltimore. He bought a motorcycle and a video camera and began a three-year, 35,000-mile motorcycle trip through Northern Africa and the Middle East.

title: Poker with Pistols
description: After losing everything in a poker game and finding himself indebted, Lucas agrees to deliver a wagon to the town of Chamaco for the $5000 payment. He soon finds himself in deep trouble with bandits, the town's local kingpin and a pretty saloon worker.

title: Polaroid
description: From the Producer of IT and IT: Chapter Two. High school loner Bird Fitcher has no idea what dark secrets are tied to the mysterious Polaroid vintage camera she stumbles upon, but it doesn't take long to discover that those who have their picture taken meet a tragic end.

title: Police Story: Lockdown
description: Jackie Chan stars as Wen, a cop with a history of violence, whose reunion with his daughter exposes a high-stakes hostage plot.

title: Polly Pocket
description: When 11 year-old Polly Pocket shrinks to four inches tall, she discovers a world of adventures where the smallest person can make the biggest difference!

title: Polly Pocket: Adventures in Rio
description: Polly and her friends head off to Rio de Janeiro where they find a lost cat that belongs to a Brazilian dancer and then embark on a tropical journey to reunite the cat with its owner.

title: Polly Pocket: Sparkle Cove Adventure
description: In the hidden world of Sparkle Cove, Polly will compete for the role of Protector and unlock new levels of magic.

title: Polly Pocket: Tiny Unicorn Adventure
description: Join Polly and her pals while they visit Unicorn Land during the super fun holiday, Unicornicopia!

title: Poltergeist
description: In this terrifying take on a classic, a suburban family tormented by inter-dimensional spirits must save their daughter from being lost to the ghosts forever!

title: Poms
description: POMS is an uplifting comedy about Martha a woman who moves into a retirement community and starts a cheerleading squad with her fellow residents, Sheryl, Olive and Alice, proving that it's never too late to follow your dreams.

title: Posh Pawn
description: This exclusive documentary series goes behind the scenes with the kings of high-end pawn broking with unprecedented access to industry experts and extraordinary clients.

title: Poster Boys
description: When broke Irishman, Al Clancy, mistakenly agrees to mind his smart-ass 10-year-old nephew, Karl, for a week, his job and home are placed in jeopardy.

title: Postman Pat: The Movie
description: Postman Pat, a mail carrier, lives an idyllic life in the quaint British town of Greendale. When a national talent TV show comes to town, Pat enters.  But when he comes face-to-face with the temptations of money – can he resist?

title: Pound of Flesh
description: In China to donate his kidney to his dying niece, Deacon Lyle (Van Damme), a former black-ops agent, awakes the day before the operation to find he is the latest victim of organ theft.

title: Press Play
description: A young woman has a chance to save the love of her life when she discovers that the mix-tape they made together can transport her back in time.

title: Pressed
description: Seeing no other option, Brian decides to go all in and invests his remaining savings into a short-term drug deal, promised to yield the funds necessary to preserve his high-flying lifestyle.

title: Pressure Point
description: Friday Night Lights meets The Social Network. Starring Oscar nominee Michael Shannon and featuring Alexander Ludwig (Vikings) and Charles Melton (Riverdale) is inspirational sports drama, Pressure Point...

title: Pretenders
description: Life imitates deadly art as French New Wave obsessed film student Terry (Jack Kilmer, The Nice Guys) and his best friend, the smooth talking Phil (Shameik Moore, Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse) are both seduced by mysterious actress Catherine (Jane Levy, Evil Dead ).

title: Prevenge
description: A pitch black, wryly British comedy from the mind of Alice Lowe, Prevenge follows Ruth, a pregnant woman on a killing spree. It's her misanthropic unborn baby dictating Ruth's actions, holding society responsible for the absence of a father.

title: Primal
description: A hunter (Nicolas Cage) must fight for his life on a ship when his deadly animals—including a rare white jaguar—are set loose by a dangerous criminal out to kill everyone on board.

title: Primal Rage
description: In an American laboratory engaged in genetic research, a scientist conducts complex experiments on monkey brain cells. One day something goes wrong and a baboon bites a student passionate about journalism. The boy falls prey to an uncontrollable fury and spreads contagion in the college.

title: Prime
description: A career driven professional from Manhattan is wooed by a young painter, who also happens to be the son of her psychoanalyst.

title: Prince Avalanche
description: Two highway road workers spend the summer of 1988 away from their city lives. The isolated landscape becomes a place of misadventure as the men find themselves at odds with each other and the women they left behind.

title: Princess and the Pony
description: A sheltered young princess is sent to live with relatives in America, where she befriends a pony held captive by a shady carnivalowner.

title: Professionals for a Massacre
description: Caught selling stolen guns, three Confederate soldiers get a reprieve from the firing squad, provided they go into Mexico on a mission to recover stolen gold belonging to the Confederacy.

title: Project Nim
description: From the Oscar-winning team behind Man on Wire comes the story of Nim, the chimpanzee who in the 1970s became the focus of a landmark experiment which aimed to show that an ape could learn to communicate with language if raised and nurtured like a human child.

title: Project Wolf Hunting
description: During an extradition to South Korea, a group of dangerous criminals unite to stage a coordinated escape attempt from their floating prison.

title: Promised
description: In 1953, two young Italian children are promised in marriage by their fathers. Twenty one years on - despite changing times, fading traditions and 70's liberation - the pair are expected to marry, or face the consequences.

title: Proximity
description: Close Encounters of the Third Kind' meets 'Independence Day'. Earth is in danger and a loner named Isaac holds the key to unravelling the mystery that will expose the truth behind alien abduction.

title: Prozac Nation
description: A talented young writer struggles with self-destructive behavior and paralyzing depression during her first year at Harvard. Featuring an all-star cast including Christina Ricci, Anne Heche and Michelle Williams.

title: Public Schooled
description: Sixteen years old and homeschooled his entire life, Liam is a socially awkward genius whose universe revolves around his single mom, Claire. When early acceptance to Cambridge University collides with love, Liam deliberately bombs his final exams and forces his way into public school...

title: Pulp: A Film About Life, Death and Supermarkets
description: PULP found fame on the world stage in the 90’s with anthems like ‘Common People’ and ‘Disco 2000’. 25 years later, they return to Sheffield for their last UK concert. Giving a career best performance exclusive to the film, the band share their thoughts on fame, love, mortality & car maintenance.

title: Pumpkin Reports
description: Max Green’s new brother and sister are aliens sent to Earth as the advance party for an invasion - and he’s the only one who can stop them turning humans into unwilling slave-gardeners.

title: Punch
description: Seventeen-year-old Jim is a small-town boxing hero who carries the hopes and dreams of his father Stan on his shoulders.

title: Pup Star
description: A Yorkshire Terrier, competing in a televised singing competition, is separated from her owner by an opportunist dog pound worker.

title: Pup Star: Better 2Gether
description: After winning Pup Star and becoming an international pup sensation, Tiny has her world turned upside down when an evil rival switches her out in competition with a street pup named Scrappy.

title: Pup Star: World Tour
description: Pup Star is back, and bigger than ever as the hit singing pup competition goes global! After achieving international stardom, Tiny the adorable Yorkie joins the inaugural Pup Star World Tour as a celebrity judge.

title: Puppy Love
