description: THE COLD LIGHT OF DAY is an adrenaline fuelled action thriller starring British star Henry Cavill (Superman: Man of Steel, Immortals) alongside Hollywood action legend Bruce Willis (Die Hard) and Sigourney  Weaver (Avatar).

title: The Commando
description: A DEA agent with PTSD returns home after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion after a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions inside of the agent's home.

title: The Commish
description: From parenthood to crime cases, Police Commissioner Tony Scali takes it day-to-day with humor and an unorthodox style of bending the rules. Starring Emmy-winner Michael Chiklis.

title: The Competition
description: Lauren Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all romantic relationships in order to prevent heartache.

title: The Complex: Lockdown
description: After being tasked with saving the life of a potential bio-weapons terrorist, two London scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time - and air - running out.

title: The Condemned 2
description: After a failed mission to capture the leader of a deadly gambling ring, bounty hunter Will Tanner becomes the hunted—a human target in a game in which contestants must kill or be killed.

title: The Confirmation
description: A divorced father and his eight-year-old son, spend a rather predictable weekend together, but when a valuable toolbox gets stolen, the search for the thieves will turn into a true family bonding.

title: The Congressman
description: A determined Congressman unswayed by political betrayal, a vicious media attack and a recent divorce strives to maintain his dignity and protect a small fishing village from commercial corruption.

title: The Cooler
description: The unluckiest man in Vegas - a guy whose bad luck is contagious is used by the last of the old mob run casinos to kill high rollers' action. That is, until he falls in love with a cocktail waitress and gets "lady luck", which throws the situation into reverse.

title: The Crossroads
description: Ex-cowboy war vet with PTSD meets hitchhiking singer/songwriter with trust issues. He shows her simpler life, they bond over inner demons. Develop relationship after finding commonalities in each other's struggles.

title: The Cup
description: Born into a legendary racing family, jockeys Damien Oliver and his brother, Jason, followed in their father's footsteps. Ray Oliver died tragically in a racing accident when the boys were young. But racing was in their blood, and Damien in particular inherited his father's gifts…

title: The Cutter
description: A determined detective (Chuck Norris) sets out to rescue an aged diamond cutter from the hands of a murderous thief in this action-packed thriller.

title: The Dagger Of Ice
description: Mute Martha lives with her uncle Ralph in the Spanish countryside. Martha’s cousin Jenny arrives to be with the family but is quickly stabbed to death. It appears that a sex maniac is roaming the countryside; killing pretty young girls. Martha seems likely to be the next victim.

title: The Daltons
description: Unshackle your laughing gas, put your ball and chain away, take a prison break and get ready to escape with the Daltons!

title: The Darkest Hour
description: Five young people find themselves stranded in Moscow, fighting to survive in the wake of a devastating alien attack.

title: The Day Shall Come
description: An impoverished preacher who brings hope to the Miami projects is offered cash to save his family from eviction.

title: The Day Time Ended
description: A futuristic solar home in the far desert was supposed to be their refuge from urban crime.  To their horror, the family discovers they're caught in a mind-boggling time warp caused by mysterious aliens with a sinister secret.

title: The Dead Mothers Club
description: Three women bound by the shared experience of having lost their mothers during adolescence yet whose paths never cross.

title: The Deal
description: Set against the backdrop of an international finance deal in New York and Peru, 'The Deal' is an intense political drama which explores how far people will go to get what they want.

title: The Death and Life of Bobby Z
description: A DEA agent (Laurence Fishburne) provides a former Marine (Paul Walker) with a way out of prison: impersonate drug dealer Bobby Z in a hostage switch with a crime lord.

title: The Deep Dark
description: Miners are forced to take a professor underground with them, to take samples for his measurements. After a landslide prevents them from going back up, they discover a crypt from another time, unknowingly waking up a bloodthirsty creature.

title: The Devil Conspiracy
description: A powerful biotech company has breakthrough technology allowing them to clone history's most influential people with just a few fragments of DNA. Behind this company is a cabal of Satanists that steals the shroud of Christ putting them in possession of Jesus' DNA.

title: The Diary of a Teenage Girl
description: A teen artist living in 1970s San Francisco enters into an affair with her mother's boyfriend...

title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby
description: This beautifully honest portrait of love follows the once happily married couple Conor and Eleanor. After being torn apart by tragedy, the couple find themselves strangers longing to reclaim the passion and life they once shared.

title: The Double
description: An edge-of-your-seat espionage thriller, starring Richard Gere and Topher Grace as ex-CIA and FBI agents, trying to find the killer of a US senator, which bears the hallmark of an infamous Soviet assassin, thought to be dead.

title: The Dreamers
description: The tumultuous political landscape of Paris in 1968 is the backdrop as three young cineastes are drawn together through their passion for film.

title: The Dresser
description: In this wickedly funny and moving story, Sir reflects on his accomplishments and seeks to reconcile his turbulent friendships with those in his employ before the final curtain.

title: The Drover's Wife: The Legend of Molly Johnson
description: In 1893, heavily pregnant Molly Johnson (Leah Purcell) and her children struggle to survive the harsh Australian landscape after her husband leaves to drove sheep in the high country.

title: The Duke
description: When the faithful canine companion to the Duke of Dingwall, Hubert, inherits the Duke’s estate, he teams up with the Butler’s niece to fend off some greedy family members.

title: The Eight Hundred
description: Shanghai 1937. It's been 3 months since Japan launched the invasion of China and Japanese forces have to take down the Si Hang Warehouse without further delay.

title: The Engineer
description: Based on the true story of the manuhunt for Hamas bomb-maker Yahya Ayyash aka "The Engineer" who sent waves of suicide bombers to busy civillian areas. The story follows the Mossad and Shin Bet, led by head agent Etan and a team of special operatives who work to eliminate him.

title: The Escape Artist
description: Will is a talented junior barrister of peerless intellect and winning charm who specializes in spiriting people out of tight legal corners. But when his talents acquit a notorious prime suspect in an horrific murder trial, that brilliance comes back to bite him with unexpected and chilling results.

title: The Escort
description: Desperate for a good story, a sex-addicted journalist throws himself into the world of high-class escorts when he starts following a Stanford-educated prostitute.

title: The Escorts
description: Guy Carter is an unemployed architect struggling to make ends meet. With bills pilling up, his wife Anne finds a job posting on Craigslist for a driver and sends Guy, against his will, for the job.

title: The Ex
description: A slacker is forced to work for his father-in-law after his pregnant wife steps away from her high-paying job.

title: The Exception
description: Iben, Malene, Anne-Lise and Camilla are four women working together, in a daily routine marked by power struggles, whispers and alliances. When Iben and Malene each receive death threats, they start to suspect a Serbian war criminal, whom they have been writing articles about.

title: The Exorcists
description: To save his family a father hires three expert exorcists to get rid of the demon possessing his child.

title: The Expatriate
description: When former CIA agent Ben Logan finds himself suddenly targeted for termination by the Agency, he is propelled into a frenzied, action-packed race against the clock for his life, with the only person left who wants or needs him alive: the 15 year-old daughter he barely knows.

title: The Eye of Satan
description: A hit-man is assigned to protect the daughter of a local gangster after her life is threatened by a rival organisation. When the hit-man is double-crossed by his employers he wreaks a violent supernatural revenge.

title: The Fabulist
description: In this inspiring and heartwarming documentary, experienced Hollywood talent agent Sandi Marx decides to take up a new career as a stand-up comedian as she copes with her declining health.

title: The Family Man
description: Investment broker, Jack (Nicolas Cage), finds his fast-lane lifestyle turned upside down when he wakes up in an alternate suburban universe where his sports car and girlfriend have become a mini-van and wife. He soon finds himself at a crossroad between his high-power career and the woman he loves.

title: The Fearless Hyena
description: Jackie Chan stars in and directs this martial arts epic. The clownish grandson (Chan) of the last of the Hsin-yi fighters inadvertently leads General Yen to his grandfather's hideout, whereupon Yen and his trio of switch-spear wielding killers put the old warrior to the sword.

title: The Fearway
description: A young couple travelling down the freeway seem to be unable to get off the road after being hunted by someone intent on keeping them on the road.

title: The Final Cut
description: In the future, a man with access to people's memories finds his life at risk when he discovers a dark secret.

title: The Fix
description: A toxic compound infects Earth's atmosphere. A troubled model's shocking transformation after taking a new drug holds the key to saving humanity.

title: The Flock
description: A hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety (Richard Gere) who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

title: The Flowers Of War
description: An American, trapped amidst the Japanese invasion of Nanking in 1937, seeks refuge in a church with a group of schoolchildren and courtesans.

title: The Forger
description: A teenager wanders into Carmel, California, where he is soon introduced to the art-forgery community.

title: The Foul King
description: A timid bank clerk transforms into a wrestling villain in this comedy starring Song Kang-ho (Parasite, Broker).

title: The Founders
description: The Founders is a story about thirteen female golfers from across the country who chose to go pro in 1950, thus creating the LPGA. The Founders played for pittances compared to men's purses, often putting their own money into the kitty.

title: The Fountain
description: Two immortally linked souls transcend the boundaries of time and space, one desperately searching for the answers that will save the other, and deliver the promise of eternal life.

title: The Fourth Victim
description: A wealthy Englishman finds his third wife dead. After the police discover that his first two wives had also died suddenly, an investigation is launched. Meanwhile, a new neighbor moves in and becomes very interested in Arthur.

title: The Gates
description: London, 1890s. William Colcott has been sentenced to death by Electric Chair. Upon his final hours, he curses the prison he resides in.

title: The Giants - Hawaii’s sumo legends
description: We follow the epic lives of sumo legends who made it from humble beginnings in Hawaii, to becoming the first foreigners to rise to the highest ranks in sumo.

title: The Girl is in Trouble
description: After spending the night with a mysterious woman, a down on his luck DJ discovers evidence of a murder involving a dangerous drug dealer and a billionaire's son.

title: The Girl Next Door
description: A young man is smitten with the beautiful girl who moves in next door, and then discovers she is an ex-porn star.

title: The Goddess of Revenge
description: Kang Hae Ra (Kim Sa Rang) has become one of the nation’s hottest influencers. But when she finds herself wrapped up in an unfounded scandal, Hae Ra wants revenge. Cha Min Joon (Yoon Hyun Min) is not a man to be trifled with.

title: The Good Lie
description: Orphaned during the Sudanese Civil War, a group of young refugees are given the opportunity to leave their camp and resettle in America.

title: The Good Neighbor
description: A pair of mischievous high school kids create the illusion of a haunting on an unsuspecting elderly neighbor while keeping his every reaction under surveillance. A series of coincidences leads to tragedy.

title: The Grand Duke of Corsica
description: A  cantankerous  and  brilliant  architect, Alfred  Rott, embarks upon a highly unusual commission for an eccentric billionaire in Malta who calls himself the ‘Grand Duke of Corsica’. A deadly malaria epidemic sweeps the island causing panic, but Alfred remains to finish the job.

title: The Grand Seduction
description: Brendan Gleeson is Murray, a once proud fisherman who now, along with his former colleagues in the harbour of Tickle Head are out of work and forced to live off welfare.

title: The Great Journey
description: A family filmed from within. The director captures his mother's fight against cancer, as his sister announces she is pregnant and his dad works on his project to redecorate the dining room of the house.

title: The Grey Zone
description: Steve Buscemi ("Fargo") and Michael Stuhlbarg ("Call Me by Your Name") star in this harrowing true story of the Jewish prisoners who staged the only armed revolt at Auschwitz.

title: The Guvnors
description: A former leader of a violent gang is dragged back to his past ways by a brutal young rival.

title: The Happytime Murders
description: An innovative film that incorporates influences from multiple genres to create a hilarious hybrid of film noir, crime drama, and cop buddy picture — with a healthy dose of R-Rated profanity and humor.

title: The Heist
description: It was a stroke of genius, but now the perfect crime is turning into a perfect disaster.

title: The Hero of Colour City
description: A diverse band of crayons strive to protect not only their magical multihued homeland but the imagination of children everywhere from a terrifying monster.

title: The Hiding Place
description: Corrie Ten Boom and her family risk everything to hide Jewish refugees by the hundreds, and they ultimately face the consequences when they are discovered.

title: The Hired Killer
description: Clint Harris, a skilled professional killer, is tasked with taking out Frank Secchy who, after betraying his partners, has gone into hiding in Paris and underwent plastic surgery. Harris accepts the assignment, but loses his brother, killed in front of him by strangers.

title: The Hole
description: From director Joe Dante comes a family-friendly adventure that explores the fears and secrets buried in the mind of kids.

title: The Hollow Point
description: Ian McShane (John Wick: Chapter 2) and Patrick Wilson (Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice) star in The Hollow Point a dark, violent and nerve-shredding Western set in a sleepy US/ Mexican border town.

title: The Honorary Consul
description: To all appearances the two men had nothing in common, but for the fact they were both residents of the Argentine outpost of Corrientes and shared an English background. Eduardo Plarr was a diligent, hardworking man of medicine; Charley Fortnum an alcoholic, good-for-nothing Honorary Consul.

title: The House of Tomorrow
description: 16-year-old Sebastian Prendergast has spent most of his life with his Nana in their geodesic dome home tourist attraction where she raises him on the futurist teachings of her former mentor Buckminster Fuller...

title: The Human Centipede (First Sequence)
description: Two pretty American girls on a road trip across Europe end up alone in the woods at night when their car breaks down in rural Germany. As they search for help they find an isolated house. Offering to call them a taxi the houses owner Dr. Heiter, a retired surgeon, invites the girls inside...

title: The Human Centipede 2 (Full Sequence)
description: To escape his dreary existence, Martin loses himself in the fantasy world of the cult horror film The Human Centipede, fetishizing the meticulous surgical skills of the gifted Dr. Heiter, whose knowledge of the human gastrointestinal system inspires Martin to attempt the unthinkable.

title: The Human Centipede 3 (Final Sequence)
description: Re-uniting the stars of the first two films The Human Centipede 3 (Final Sequence) is the finale the worlds sickest horror franchise deserves. Nasty, revolting, and utterly deplorable.

title: The Human Race
description: Eighty people are abducted from a city street by an unknown entity and forced to participate in a brutal race to the death.

title: The Humanity Bureau
description: In the near future, natural disasters, famine and war have ripped America apart, creating the police state of New America.

title: The Hurricane
description: From Oscar nominated director Norman Jewison (Moonstruck, In the Heat of the Night) comes a tense biographical drama based on the true story of Rubin 'Hurricane' Carter (Oscar winner Denzel Washington), a man who rose up from his troubled childhood to become a boxing champion.

title: The Hustle
description: Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway) is a glamorous, seductive Brit with a penchant for defrauding gullible wealthy men. Into her well-ordered world bursts Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), an Aussie who is as free-form and fun-loving as Josephine is calculated and cunning.

title: The Iceman
description: The Iceman is the story of real-life mob hitman Richard "The Iceman" Kuklinski, who was reportedly responsible for over 200 murders. .

title: The Immigrant
description: Marion Cotillard, Joaquin Phoenix, and Jeremy Renner star in the story of Ewa, a recent immigrant to America who falls prey to a charming but wicked man who forces her into prostitution.

title: The Imposters
description: Maya meets the enigmatic Hattie. They fall for each other, but soon, things begin to unravel as Maya realises that Hattie has ulterior motives and everything is not as it seems.

title: The Intent 2: The Come Up
description: Jay has no money, his car keeps getting towed away, every move he makes to lift himself out of the everyday struggle is unsuccessful. He works for ruthless Yardie boss Beverley but has ambitions to set up his own organized crime ring.

title: The Intergalactic Adventures of Max Cloud
description: When video-game enthusiast, Sarah (Isabelle Allen), is transported into her favorite game, she finds herself on an intergalactic prison, home to the most dangerous villains in the galaxy.

title: The Internet's Own Boy: The Story of Aaron Swartz
description: The Internet’s Own Boy follows the story of programming prodigy and information activist Aaron Swartz. It was Swartz's groundbreaking work in social justice combined with his aggressive approach to information access that ensnared him in a two-year legal nightmare.

title: The Internship
description: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

title: The Irish Connection
description: A female British agent Aureille is sent to Ireland to investigate the robbery of Bearer Bonds by Rory Baker. Betrayed and set up by a Priest, the agent goes Rogue in Malta, dodging the Baker's ruthless hit men and worse, her own boss Miranda.

title: The Jacket
description: A Gulf war veteran is sent to a mental institution for insane criminals, where he becomes the object of a doctor's experiments and lands in a terrifying predicament between his past and his future in this mind-bending tale.

title: The Jesus Rolls
description: A boundary breaking, comedy caper with John Turturro reprising the much loved role of Jesus Quintana.

title: The Joker
description: A young detective becomes an unwilling participant in a sadistic game of cat and mouse when he is kidnapped by a calculating serial killer. In order to survive, the detective must use the wisdom and hindsight imparted to him from senior detectives on their regular poker night.

title: The Jurassic Games
description: Each year, 10 dangerous criminals compete for their freedom in a virtual reality tv show where contestants must survive ferocious dinosaurs like velociraptors and T Rex. Die in the game, and you die in real life. The last one left alive will be granted not only his freedom, but fame and fortune.

title: The Keeper
description: The Keeper tells the incredible true story of Bert Trautmann (David Kross), a German soldier and prisoner of war who, against a backdrop of British post-war protest and prejudice, secures the position of Goalkeeper at Manchester City, and in doing so becomes a footballing icon.

title: The Key to Christmas
description: When a disgruntled Head Elf is kicked off the toy-making team by Santa Claus, she decides to get revenge by taking over the North Pole, capturing Mrs. Claus, and turning back time to “De-Santa-ize” Santa—making him younger and younger every minute!

title: The Kid
description: A young fugitive is drawn into the world of Pat Garrett and Billy the Kid as he makes his way across the American Southwest in a desperate attempt to save his sister’s life.

title: The Killer
description: Ui-gang is a retired hitman. While his wife goes on a trip with her friend, she asks him a special favour to take care of her friend's daughter.

title: The Kindred
description: A woman suffering from amnesia pieces together the events that led to her father's suicide, only to be haunted by the ghosts of children that she begins to suspect were murdered by him.

title: The King Loves
description: Power, friendship or love? Wang Won (Im Siwan) is the Crown Prince during the Goryeo Dynasty who harbors an extreme lust for power. His childhood friend, Wang Rin (Hong Jong Hyun), is his trusted ally and bodyguard.

title: The King Of Bloody Fookin Britain
description: Roger Sykes and his small-time London gang, Her Majesty's Misfits, rip the mob off of an infamously rare shipment of chang called Malagasy Cocaine. In their quick attempt to sell the drugs, the renegades are catapulted into a chaotic fight for their lives.

title: The King Of Comedy
description: A struggling comedian gambles his uncertain future on a crazy scheme to ransom his way onto television by kidnapping a popular talk show host.

title: The Krays: Gangsters Behind Bars
description: Fascinated by the Krays, Steve Wraith earns their trust through letters and visits, only to be groomed into their outside affairs. Using rare correspondence, calls, and interviews, this film reveals the terrifying power of the Krays—even behind bars.

title: The Krays: Mad Axeman
description: Based on the true story of Frank Mitchell who was sprung from Dartmoor Prison by the Krays 10 days before Christmas 1966. Whilst a national manhunt ensued, he was holed up in a flat in East London with a minder and hostess for company. 'The Mad Axeman' is a gripping suspense crime thriller.

title: The Last Act
description: Simon Axler is a famed stage actor who becomes depressed and then suicidal when he loses his gift. In an attempt to get his mojo back, he has an affair with a lesbian woman half his age.

title: The Last Days of Frankie the Fly
description: Dennis Hopper ("Easy Rider") stars as a low-level mob man who dreams of changing his life and winds up trying to help a drug-addicted porn queen become a legitimate actress. Featuring Michael Madsen, Daryl Hannah and Kiefer Sutherland.

title: The Last Deal
description: A black market marijuana dealer tries to make one final score before getting squeezed out of the business when cannabis becomes legal.

title: The Last Face
description: Set against the devastating backdrop of war-torn Liberia, The Last Face centers on a love affair between Dr. Miguel Leon, a relief-aid doctor, and Dr. Wren Petersen), the director of an international aid organization. Directed by Two-time Academy Award® winner Sean Penn.

title: The Last Five Years
description: A struggling actress and her novelist lover each illustrate the struggle and deconstruction of their love affair.

title: The Last Front
description: Amidst World War I's chaos, a grieving father turns hero, leading villagers to safety while evading a relentless enemy driven by vengeance.

title: The Last Full Measure
description: Thirty four years after his death, Airman William H. Pitsenbarger, Jr. Pits is awarded the nations highest military honor, for his actions on the battlefield.

title: The Last Grind
description: A teenage skateboarder suffering from a recent family tragedy comes up with a money-making scheme that embroils him in something far bigger than he ever dreamed. Only his mum and emo ex-girlfriend can save him from a terrifying fate.

title: The Last Heist
description: From the Producers of Once Upon a Time in London comes The Last Heist. Four old school villains, Waldorf, Prozac, Fisherman and Slips plan one 'Last Heist' to liberate the key to the recently past away, head of South London crime family, Mick.

title: The Last Journey
description: The red moon threatens existence on earth. The only hope is the enigmatic Paul WR, the most talented astronaut of his generation. But hours before the start of the Great mission, Paul disappears.

title: The Last Legion
description: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

title: The Last Manhunt
description: In 1909 Willie Boy and his love, Carlota, go on the run after he accidentally shoots her father in a confrontation. With President Taft coming to the area, the local sheriff leads two Native American trackers to hunt them down.

title: The Last Scout
description: After the earth is destroyed by war, a scout team of astronauts searches the universe for an habitable place to save the human race.

title: The Last Sharknado: It's About Time
description: Fin has to go back in time to rejoin his shark-battling friends to stop the first Sharknado and save humanity.

title: The Last Taboo (Director's cut)
description: The feature-length documentary THE LAST TABOO allows Thomas Hitzlsperger and those who have broken this very taboo to tell their very personal stories. Like the British professional footballer Justin Fashanu, who first broke this taboo in 1990 and paid for it with his life.

title: The Last Witch Hunter
description: Centuries ago, the mighty warrior Kaulder (Vin Diesel) vanquished the all-powerful Witch Queen, but in the moments before his death he was cursed with immortality.

title: The Late Bloomer
description: The story of an adult male who, after the successful removal of a benign tumor resting against his pituitary gland, experiences all the changes and effects of puberty over a three-week period.

title: The Legend of Barney Thomson
description: Comedy drama as Robert Carlyle plays Barney Thomson, a downtrodden barber who has fallen from grace in his meagre barbering life. One day whilst almost losing his job, Barney comically falls into the unthinkable role of a serial killer.

title: The Legend Of Hercules
description: In the epic origin story the legend of Hercules,  a half-god, half-man blessed with extraordinary streng. Betrayed by his stepfather, the king, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love,  Hercules must use his formidable powers.

title: The Legend of La Llorona
description: While vacationing in Mexico, a couple discovers their son's disappearance is tied to a supernatural curse.

title: The Light Between Oceans
description: Based on the bestselling novel by M.L. Stedman and from acclaimed director Derek Cianfrance, The Light Between Oceans is a beautiful and heart-breaking reminder of the infinite power of love and the lengths that we’ll go to in order to protect it.

title: The Little Alien
description: When a little alien named Britney crashes her spaceship on planet Earth, 11-year-old Allan enlists the help of his UFO-obsessed neighbour. Together they must hatch a plan to get Britney back to outer space before it's too late.

title: The Little Mermaid
description: In this "half-fish" out-of-water animated adventure, a mermaid princess makes a bargain with a sea witch to become human.

title: The Little Vampire
description: From the screenwriters of Chicken Run and The Addams Family, comes The Little Vampire: a fantastic adventure that you can really sink your teeth into!

title: The Lost Bladesman
description: During the warring period of the three kingdoms, ancient China is in turmoil. To unify the country general Cao Cao (Jiang Wen), enlists the aid of the greatest warrior in the land Guan Yun Change (Donnie Yen).

title: The Lost Daughter
description: A young woman follows a mysterious melody onto a remote tidal island. When she crosses back over at the next low tide, she emerges into a world where 25 years have passed.

title: The Lost Weekend: A Love Story
description: A story 50 years in the making that will resonate deeply with anyone captivated by the magic of John Lennon and the complexities of human relationships.

title: The Love Witch
description: Elaine, a beautiful young witch, is determined to find a man to love her. In her gothic Victorian apartment she makes spells and potions. She then picks up men and seduces them, but her spells work too well, leaving her with a string of hapless victims.

title: The Magic of Belle Isle
description: An alcoholic novelist (Morgan Freeman) rediscovers his passion for writing, and for life, when he begrudgingly befriends a single mother.

title: The Magistrate
description: Augusto Vanghetta is the city praetor, but his true passions are women and theatre. With a marriage in crisis for a long time, Augusto, not particularly handsome, uses the power and prestige of his office to attract women.

title: The Magnificent Texan
description: Manuel Lopez is a tough, gun-wielding saloon owner who helps Mexican peasants oppose a notorious land baron who is cruelly oppressing them.

title: The Man in the Hat
description: The Man in the Hat (Ciarán Hinds) journeys through France in a Fiat 500 accompanied by a framed photograph of an unknown woman. He is pursued by five angry men in a Citroën Dyane.

title: The Man in the White Van
description: A true-crime, Hitchcockian thriller set in 1970's Florida; an ominous white van stalking a young girl leads to a terrifying Halloween nightmare.

title: The Man Standing Next
description: A critically acclaimed, taut spy thriller based on shocking true events from the director of the celebrated The Drug King.

title: The Man with the Iron Heart
description: THE MAN WITH THE IRON HEART, is a story about one of the most dangerous figures in the Nazi regime, and the brave men and women of the Resistance, who sought to take him down.

title: The Man Without a Face
description: A drama film about a young boy who befriends a disfigured recluse in a small coastal town; and helps him overcome his fear of society and confront his past.

title: The Marker
description: Convicted for manslaughter, troubled young criminal Marley spends his time behind bars struggling to come to terms with the grief and guilt of his crime. Upon his release, he determines to set things rights by finding and protecting his victim’s daughter Cristina...

title: The Martini Shot
description: This existential comedy follows an ailing movie director as he shoots what he believes to be his final work of art. What starts out as a normal movie, ends up being an exploration of mortality and one's profound effect on the world.

title: The Match
description: "The Match" tells the story of the true events which transpired in the spring of 1944 when Nazis organized a football match between the Hungarian prisoners and an elite Nazi team to commemorate Adolf Hitler’s birthday.

title: The Midnight Meat Train
description: A New York photographer hunts down a serial killer who butchers his victims on subway trains. Starring Bradley Cooper, based on Clive Barker's short story.

title: The Mill Killers
description: Four girls return home to a ghost town but find themselves being followed. By someone who knows what they did? Or just their guilty conscience? There's more to each girl than meets the eye.

title: The Minute You Wake Up Dead
description: AS THE BODIES PILE UP, HIS WORLD WILL FALL APART. An investment banker in small town America finds one mistake could cost him his life as his clients lose vast amounts of money. As the threats begin to pile in, one call asks “Where will you be the minute you wake up dead?”.

title: The Miracle of Marcelino
description: Friars take a child in bundles and raise him with care and love. Becoming older, Marcellino feels the need for a friend, and finds him in a crucifix abandoned in the attic of the convent. A tender friendship is established between the child and the effigy.

title: The Miseducation of Cameron Post
description: After being caught with another girl in the back seat of a car on prom night, Cameron is shipped off to a conversion therapy centre that treats teens "struggling with same-sex attraction".

title: The Missing Sister
description: When Sharon finally tracks down her missing sister Raven, she’s elated to be back together – until she begins to suspect that Raven isn’t her sister at all, but rather an opportunistic imposter.

title: The Modelizer
description: When his playboy charms fail to snag the headstrong Camila, a Brazilian model with her stilettos firmly on the ground, Shawn must change his tactics and clean up his act if he intends to win her heart.

title: The Monster Beneath Us
description: When her estranged husband James suddenly dies, Grace and their son Charlie are forced to move to his country estate, where they both struggle to adapt to a new lifestyle. At first, Grace doesn’t take much notice when Charlie mentions he has a new friend who lives in the basement.

title: The Moogai
description: A young Aboriginal couple brings home their second baby. What should be a joyous time takes a sinister turn, as the baby's mother starts seeing a malevolent spirit she is convinced is trying to take her baby.

title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
description: Clary Fray thinks she is just an ordinary teenager living in Brooklyn, but everything changes one night when in a downtown club she encounters the mysterious and charismatic Jace , and witnesses a shocking murder.

title: The Mother/Daughter Experiment: Celebrity Edition
description: The Mother/Daughter Experiment: Celebrity Edition features six mother/daughter pairs who will air their dirty laundry in order to repair their broken relationships. Pairs include Kim Richards and her daughter Kimberly Jackson.

title: The Music of Silence
description: Before he was Andrea Bocelli, he was Amos Bardi. Based on a true story, Amos is born with the gift of superb quality of voice. From there, he begins a life studded with victories and becomes one of the most world-renowned opera singers.

title: The Nanny
description: A wealthy couple hire a young girl from Finland to take care of their newborn. These new parents should be in a state of bliss, so why does it seem like they are trying to kill each other?

title: The Neighbour
description: The Neighbour follows Mike, a middle-aged man in a routine marriage, wrestling with the fact that he feels his life to be passing him by. Yet, when a young couple moves in next door, Mike quickly befriends the young and vulnerable Jenna - herself trapped in a tumultuous marriage to Scott...

title: The Neon Demon
description: Dark horror thriller; when aspiring model Jesse (Elle Fanning) moves to Los Angeles to embark on her career, her youth and vitality are devoured by a group of beauty-obsessed women who will use any means necessary to get what she has in The Neon Demon, the new film from Nicolas Winding Refn.

title: The New Girlfriend
description: Starring Romain Duris and based on the story by Ruth Rendell, The New Girlfriend is a witty and hilarious take on gender and sexuality, from internationally-acclaimed director François Ozon.

title: The New Music
description: After a Parkinson's diagnosis a classically trained pianist embarks on a path of self discovery leading him to a punk band. Their rebellious lifestyle and music provide a distraction to his troubles and a sharp contrast to his old life.

title: The Next Girl
description: A young woman is abducted by a strange group of human traffickers who use drug and trauma based mind control to turn women into living dolls. Trapped in a waking nightmare she fights for a way to escape, to avoid becoming the next victim.

title: The Night Clerk
description: Hotel night clerk Bart Bromley (Tye Sheridan - READY PLAYER ONE), a highly intelligent young man on the Autism spectrum, uses covert surveillance cameras to record guests in efforts to improve his social interaction skills.

title: The Nightingale
description: Set in 1825. A young Irish convict woman chases a British officer through the rugged Tasmanian wilderness, bent on revenge for a terrible act of violence he committed against her family.

title: The Ninth Gate
description: Johnny Depp unlocks the gates of hell in the tense thriller directed by Roman Polanski. After a rare-book dealer (Depp) is hired to locate the last copies of a demonic manuscript, he's swept into a web of theft, murder, and terrifying satanic rituals.

title: The Nomads
description: Amidst the chaos of massive budget cuts and school closures, a newly appointed teacher introduces men's rugby to an inner-city North Philadelphia high school.

title: The Novice
description: An obsessive college freshman joins her university's rowing team and undertakes an extreme physical and psychological journey to make it to the top varsity boat, no matter the cost.

title: The Nowhere Inn
description: From real-life friends Annie Clark and Carrie Brownstein comes the metafictional account of two creative forces banding together to make a documentary about St. Vincent's music, touring life, and on-stage persona.

title: The Nutcracker
description: Nine-year-old Mary lives in a home filled with lovely things and loneliness. Bothered by bratty brother Max and neglected by well intentioned, but distracted, parents, she yearns for companionship. On Christmas Eve, Mary's Uncle Albert arrives with the gift of a wooden nutcracker doll…

title: The Nutcracker Sweet
description: It's Christmas Eve, a night of excitement and wonderment for the Silberhaus children. Presented with a magical Nutcracker from their loving godfather, Marie and Fritz are destined for a night they will never forget.

title: The Odyssey (2016)
description: 1948, Jacques Cousteau, his wife and his two sons are living in paradise, in a beautiful house overlooking the Mediterranean. But all Cousteau can think of is adventure. Thanks to his invention, an independent aqualung allowing divers to breathe under water, he has discovered a whole new world.

title: The Old Woman with the Knife
description: Based on the bestselling novel of the same name, this adrenaline-charged revenge thriller follows legendary female assassin Hornclaw (Lee Hye-yeong), a veteran killer with a knack for taking out society's worst.

title: The Open Road
description: Upon learning of his mother's sudden heart condition, Carlton Garrett is faced with the challenge of fulfilling her dire wish to bring his estranged father to the hospital before the operation.

title: The Order
description: Martial arts icon Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as a playboy criminal thrust into a dangerous world of ancient evil when he must investigate the disappearance of his archaeologist father. With Oscar winner Charlton Heston and Sofia Milos.

title: The Other
description: After years of struggling with infertility, Robin and Daniel, realize their dreams of parenthood by bringing Kathelia, a mute orphan, with a dark and mysterious past into their home.

title: The Other Man
description: Suspicious that his late wife was having an affair on her frequent business trips, Peter flies to Milan in search of answers, leading to obsession and paranoia as he unravels the story behind her secret second life with another man.

title: The Outsider
description: In the vein of Taken, Craig Fairbrass stars as Lex, who’s told that his daughter has died in LA. However, he finds that the body isn't his daughter, and that an internet fraudster has her hostage. Lex sets out to save his daughter, wreaking havoc through the streets of LA trying to rescue her.

title: The Pack
description: The Draymen Estate has become an urban legend. Amongst the sinister stories of unsavoury locals and brutal violence, several people have apparently gone missing.

title: The Painted
description: A suburban family’s summer plans are unexpectedly interrupted when they are called to a deceased relative's estate, where they begin to unravel the secrets that haunt the premises.

title: The Party
description: Janet (Kristin Scott Thomas) has just been appointed to a key ministerial position in the shadow cabinet - the crowning achievement of her political career. She and her husband Bill (Timothy Spall) plan to celebrate this with a few close friends.

title: The Party Crasher
description: A fraternity house throws their big "Winter Luau" party but when fraternity brothers and coeds begin dying horrible deaths they discover an evil entity has taken over the house.

title: The Party's Just Beginning
description: A darkly humorous and moving coming of age story written, directed and starring Karen Gillan.

title: The Passenger
description: A naive young husband must face down his obsessive and psychotic friend when their plan to elicit a confession from his adulterous wife ends in murder.

title: The Passion Within
description: The film starts in the trip from Sevilla to Linares, where Manolete stops in Córdoba to see his mother. He will be remembering some passages of his life.

title: The Path
description: After her parents death, a young woman returns home to care for her sister and soon discovers the dark past surrounding her family’s farm.

title: The Peddler
description: Daniel Burmeister, a bearded film buff, goes from town to town making ultra low-budget films starring the locals themselves - and in record time!

title: The People We Hate at the Wedding
description: Dysfunctional American siblings Alice and Paul -- along with their ever-optimistic mom-- are invited to the British wedding of their estranged half-sister, Eloise, as a chance for them to reconnect as – more or less – adults, and learn to love each other like they once did.

title: The Perception
description: Richard (Jon Wright), an uninspired novelist suffering from paranoid delusions, suspects his young and beautiful wife, Haley (Sandi Gardner), of having an affair. He hires Matt (Nick Bateman) to confirm his suspicions but the plan goes terribly wrong.

title: The Philosophers
description: At an international school in Jakarta, a philosophy teacher challenges his class of twenty graduating seniors to choose which ten of them would take shelter underground and reboot the human race in the event of a nuclear apocalypse.

title: The Pig Farmer
description: When a local cop and an overzealous social-worker follow clues on missing persons cases around town, stomach-turning discoveries are unearthed on a pig farm, where the town butcher has been slaughtering more than livestock.

title: The Poseidon Explosion
description: An ocean liner’s cargo of fertilizer ignites, causing an explosion which sets the whole ship ablaze. As the crew and passengers are plunged into a fiery fight for survival, an unlikely duo – a heroic newlywed and a resourceful stowaway – rally to help the stricken survivors.

title: The Preppie Connection
description: A student at a private school uses his connections to establish a drug trafficking network there.

title: The Price for Silence
description: After the death of her father, a troubled woman returns home to confront the family who paid for her silence.

title: The Price We Pay
description: After a pawn shop robbery goes askew, two criminals take refuge at a remote farmhouse to try to let the heat die down, but find something much more menacing.

title: The Prince
description: Bruce Willis, John Cusack and Jason Patric face off in this action-packed thriller. A retired assassin is drawn back into the life he gave up when his daughter is kidnapped. To rescue her, he must confront his former rival.

title: The Princess
description: Princess Diana's story is told exclusively through contemporaneous archive creating a bold and immersive narrative of her life and death. It also illuminates how the public's attitude to the monarchy was, and still is.

title: The Private Lives of Pippa Lee
description: Adapted from the best-selling novel of the same name and with an all star cast, Pippa Lee (Robin Wright Penn) seems to have everything in life, but suddenly finds herself questioning it all as unexpected encounters, affairs and betrayals start to unravel everything.

title: The Problem With People
description: Honouring his father's last wish to reunite with the American side of his family, Irishman Ciáran (Colm Meaney) calls his cousin, Barry (Paul Reiser), out of the blue with the offer for him to visit his homeland.

title: The Promise
description: It is 1914. As the Great War looms, the mighty Ottoman Empire is crumbling. Constantinople, the once vibrant, multicultural capital on the shores of the Bosporus, is about to be consumed by chaos.

title: The Promotion
description: Two assistant managers of a corporate grocery store contend for a coveted promotion and will stop at nothing to get it.

title: The Propaganda Game
description: Documentary feature directed by Alvaro Longoria that analyses Propaganda and the different techniques and strategies in place, focusing on North Korea as a surprising and fascinating case study.

title: The Protector
description: After the kidnapping of a wealthy tycoon's daughter, maverick NYPD cops Jackie Chan and Danny Aiello are sent to find leads in Hong Kong, but they find themselves beset by the local kingpin, who will stop at nothing to protect his drug empire.

title: The Protector
description: After being released from a correctional facility and moving to a small town, Evelyn struggles and searches for meaning that is interrupted by the arrival of a mysterious book about a powerful God who brings peace wherever he goes.

title: The Public
description: The Public is about downtown Cincinnati librarians Stuart Goodson and Myra who see their regular winter day shaken up when homeless patrons decide to take shelter in their library for the night. What starts as a peaceful sit-in quickly escalates into a face-off with the police and the media.

title: The Queen of Spain
description: It's the 1950s, as the film diva Macarena Granada (Penelope Cruz - 'Murder on the Orient Express') returns from Hollywood to Spain to shoot a US blockbuster entitled 'The Queen of Spain', where she will breathe new-life into her most loved character Isabella I of Castile.

title: The Quiet American
description: An old British reporter (Michael Caine) vies with a young U.S. doctor (Brendan Fraser) for the affections of a beautiful Vietnamese woman.

title: The Railway Man
description: Eric Lomax was one of thousands of Allied prisoners of war forced to work on the construction of the Thai/Burma railway during WW2. Years later, he met Patti and fell in love. Discovering that the young Japanese officer who haunted her husband was still alive, she faced a terrible decision.

title: The Rape of Recy Taylor
description: THE RAPE OF RECY TAYLOR is a documentary about a 24-year old black mother and sharecropper who was gang raped by six white men in 1944 Alabama. She spoke up at the time and identified her rapists. The NAACP sent Rosa Parks, their chief investigator and civil rights activist to look into the case...

title: The Ravine
description: When an unspeakable crime rocks a peaceful community, family and friends are left to wonder if they overlooked the murderer among them or if there might be more to the story. Inspired by true events.

title: The Re-Education of Molly Singer
description: In college, attorney Molly Singer (Britt Robertson) was the life of every party. Now, she's about to be fired because she can't leave her hard-partying ways behind.

title: The Real Charlie Chaplin
description: A look at the life and work of Charlie Chaplin in his own words featuring an in-depth interview he gave to Life magazine in 1966.

title: The Reason I Jump
description: Based on the bestselling book by Naoki Higashida, The Reason I Jump is an immersive cinematic exploration of neurodiversity through the experiences of nonspeaking autistic people from around the world.

title: The Reef
description: A ferocious shark stalks a group of friends seeking safety after a shipwreck.

title: The Reef: Stalked
description: After Nic and Annie witness the horrific murder of their sister, they try to escape the trauma by traveling to a remote Pacific Island with two close friends for a kayaking adventure. But within hours of arriving, the women are attacked far from land by a great white shark.

title: The Rest of Us
description: Four women must contend with their own grief, truths, flaws and secrets while ultimately deciding if the past will dictate their future.

title: The Resurrection of Charles Manson
description: While a couple creates an audition tape for an up-and-coming Charles Manson film, the dark events of the audition material slowly slip into their reality as they find themselves intertwined in an occult leader's sinister plot.

title: The Return is the Movement of Tao
description: This fascinating musical documentary explores the career of Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei, with a particular focus on her quintessential piece: Bach's The Goldberg Variations.

title: The Rev
description: 1985: Detective Inspector Gwyn Roberts is sent to a quiet seaside town to investigate an unusually threatening and vile anonymous letter, leading him to the home of mild-mannered clergymen, the Reverend Emyr Owen.

title: The Rewrite
description: Once upon a time, screenwriter Keith Michaels was on top of the world. But now, he’s divorced, broke and hasn’t written a hit film in years. His attitude slowly begins to turn when he meets Holly, a single mum.

title: The Ride
description: The inspiring story of a BMX champion who overcame an abusive childhood through the love and life lessons of his foster family.

title: The Rider
description: After suffering a near fatal head injury, a young cowboy undertakes a search for new identity and what it means to be a man in the heartland of America.

title: The Rifleman
description: The Rifleman pays stark witness to the horrors and brutality of WWI, as seen through the eyes of an innocent 17-year-old farm-boy, turned soldier.

title: The Rise
description: Battered, bruised and under arrest, Harvey Miller sits in a police interview room facing interrogation. Denying nothing, Harvey agrees to tell his version of events in full. We take in his release from prison a month earlier and the malevolent, unjust act that put him there.

title: The Ritual
description: Father Theophilus Riesinger and Father Joseph Steiger, the former struggling with his faith and the latter dealing with his past, work together to complete a series of exorcisms on Emma Schmidt, a young woman who's allegedly experiencing demonic possession.

title: The Ritual Killer
description: A troubled detective embarks on a hunt for a serial killer who murders according to a brutal tribal ritual.

title: The Road to Galena
description: Cole Baird appears to have everything, but behind the façade he's trapped by his surroundings and falling behind in pursuit of his life's dream. He now has a choice: continue a life to which he never aspired or follow the path to fulfillment.

title: The Runaways
description: Los Angeles 1975, Joan Jett and Cherie Currie, two teenage valley girls with punk in their blood, meet and become the heart and soul of the seminal all girl band, The Runaways.

title: The Runners
description: When his little sister is abducted from a homecoming after-party in rural East Texas, Ryan is in a race against the clock to save her before she disappears into the underworld of sex trafficking forever.

title: The S.S. Swenson
description: Grieving the loss of their father, they've descended deep into a life of crime and drug/alcohol abuse. In their delusion, everything they beg, borrow and steal is so that they can buy a boat and embark on a cleansing journey.

title: The sea of trees
description: Arthur Brennan treks into Aokigahara, known as The Sea of Trees, a mysterious dense forest at the base of Japan's Mount Fuji where people go to commit suicide.

title: The Seagull
description: In the early twentieth century, an aging actress and her lover visit the estate of her elderly brother.

title: The Secret of Sinchanee
description: An industrial tow truck driver suffering from insomnia returns to his childhood home after the untimely death of his father, to discover that a paranormal presence has been living in the house and haunting the sacred land it was built on.

title: The Secret Romantic Guesthouse
description: Scholars Kang San (Ryeoun), Kim Shi Yeol (Kang Hoon), and Jeong Yoo Ha (Jung Gun Joo) have all come to the capital to take the civil service entrance exam – in the hope of one day becoming top-ranking public officials.

title: The Secret Scripture
description: Lady Rose (Vanessa Redgrave) is an elderly woman who has lived in a hospital for over 50 years. Despite her bleak surroundings there is a light in her eyes that cannot be extinguished. Dr. Stephen Grene (Eric Bana) is drawn to her, compelled to discover her past and help gain her freedom.

title: The Secrets of La Roja – World Champions 2010
description: On the 11th July 2010, Spain’s national team reached its goal of winning the World Cup, a victory that was felt by the team and nation as a whole. Despite this successful ending, “La Roja” had to overcome various struggles and difficulties in order to become legendary.

title: The Sentinel
description: Compromised by his affair with the first lady, a veteran secret service agent is framed as a potential presidential assassin and must rely on a hostile former protégé to flush out the real culprit.

title: The Seven Faces of Jane
description: Jane sheds her mundane life and experiences romance, comedy, tragedy and existential crises on a surreal road trip as imagined by eight different directors who had no knowledge of each other's segment.

title: The Shanghai Job
description: A washed-up private security agent has to escort a valuable Chinese antique out of Shanghai but is ambushed en route.

title: The Shore Break
description: Two cousins from a close-knit rural community have opposing plans to develop their homeland on South Africa's Wild Coast.

title: The Siege
description: Walker, an international assassin, is compromised during a mission. His handler sends him to a Reassignment Center at which Walker will be processed for a new identity. During his stay at the facility, a ruthless assault team storms the compound searching for someone their boss has lost.

title: The Sixth Secret
description: At a late-night seance, attended by twelve people, the medium announces that five secrets will be revealed before midnight. There might, however, be one more - the darkest of them all.

title: The Slaughter Rule
description: A young man finds solace with a young woman, his mother, and a high-school football coach who recruits him to quarterback a six-man team.

title: The Smurfs
description: The Smurfs are cheerful little blue characters. Follow their most exciting and magical adventures!

title: The Snowtown Murders
description: Based on true events. A violent predator takes teenage Jamie under his wing, making him an accomplice in a murder spree.

title: The Son of No One
description: A young cop (Channing Tatum) is assigned to a precinct in the working class neighborhood where he grew up, where an old secret threatens to destroy his family.

title: The Song To My Heart
description: After a childhood on the road with her legendary singer-songwriter father, teashop owner BONNIE HIGHSTREET, wants nothing to do with the music business, but when she helps music sensation RYDER JAMISON, develop lyrics for his new solo album, she rekindles her long abandoned dream and falls in love.

title: The Sound of Belgium
description: Sometimes frantic, sometimes thoughtful, this documentary, as educational as it is entertaining, is a journey through the world of dance music in Belgium, where modern Europe was born.

title: The Spy Gone North
description: The Spy Gone North is a critically-acclaimed, edge of your seat spy thriller from director Jong-Bin Yoon.

title: The Spy Next Door
description: Former CIA spy takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids.

title: The State of Texas vs. Melissa
description: This documentary explores the life journey of Melissa Lucio, the first Hispanic woman sentenced to death in Texas. For ten years she has been awaiting her fate, and she now faces her last appeal.

title: The Stoic
description: After a successful drug-gang raid, a group of mercenary leaders hide out at a country retreat. Their escape unravels when they attract the attention of The Stoic—a relentless figure from an ancient smuggler clan.

title: The Successor
description: The Successor follows a former manufacturer of landmines in Bosnia and Herzegovina on a journey where he will have the opportunity to come to terms with himself and face the ghosts of his past.

title: The Sun is Also a Star
description: “What if I told you I could get you to fall in love with me…?” College-bound romantic Daniel Bae (Melton) and Jamaica-born pragmatist Natasha Kingsley (Shahidi) meet—and fall for each other—over one magical day amidst the fervor and flurry of New York City...

title: The Swearing Jar
description: "The Swearing Jar" is a gorgeous musical romance that asks the question — is it possible to meet your "one true love", twice?

title: The Swordsman
description: After the fall of King Gwanghae, Joseon's greatest swordsman and royal guard Tae-yul is forced into hiding. In the meantime, Joseon is caught between the Qing and Ming dynasties' conflict, and is at the mercy of Qing's envoy and slave trader Kurutai's ridiculous demands.

title: The Tall Man
description: COLD ROCK, U.S.A. - on the surface just a small town like any other. However, the residents of Cold Rock are quietly living with a horrible truth: their children keep disappearing, leaving neither a clue nor a witness.

title: The Tenants
description: In an abandoned tenement, an African-American militant writer (Snoop Dogg, "Training Day") and a Jewish novelist (Dylan McDermott, "Olympus Has Fallen") develop a friendship while struggling to complete their novels.

title: The Tiny Life of Butcher Duke
description: A middle-aged failed Tennis coach gets a second chance at life when the son of his arch enemy offers up a rematch for the ages.

title: The Toybox
description: On a family vacation in their new RV, Charles and his family stop to pick up a couple who have broken down in the desert. Now stranded in the middle of nowhere, the identities of their hitch hikers are revealed and the family find themselves in a fight for their lives.

title: The Tracker
description: Ten years ago, Aiden Hakansson's wife and daughter were kidnapped and killed in Italy during an exchange of prisoners gone wrong. Since then, Aiden has been living in the USA, isolated from the world, woken every night by nightmares and memories.

title: The Transporter Refuelled
description: Ed Skrein plays Frank Martin, a former special-ops mercenary, who now works transporting classified packages for questionable people in the south of France.

title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
description: Medina Mason (Maika Monroe) attempts to find her place at a new school in the affluent beach community of Palos Verdes, California.

title: The Trust
description: A pair of cops investigating a drug invasion stumble upon a mysterious bank vault.

title: The Twisters
description: Dozens of deadly tornadoes converge in the Midwest, merging into a mega twister set to obliterate everything for hundreds of miles.

title: The Unholy Four
description: A young man who has lost his memory escapes from prison with three other convicts. The other men help him find back bits of his past until they arrive at a village where he is caught in a feud between his family and the father of one of the robbers.

title: The Unseen
description: A man who abandoned his family now risks everything to find his missing daughter, including exposing the secret that he is becoming invisible.

title: The Unsellables
description: The Unsellables is a bold new property show that helps desperate homeowners transform their ‘unsellable’ homes. Hosted by Sofie Allsopp, and packed with practical advice, learn how to turn an unwanted house into an unstoppable hot property.

title: The Valley of Salt
description: It is Egypt after the fall of Mubarak. A young Egyptian filmmaker films his Christian parents during the tense course of the Christmas days as they face a threat of death for religious reasons.

title: The Vigil
description: A man providing overnight watch to a deceased member of his former Orthodox Jewish community finds himself opposite a malevolent entity.

title: The Vindicator
description: A serial killer disrupts a live streaming true crime podcast and challenges the hosts to nightmarish tasks, that expose their darkest transgressions, for the chance to uncover their identity.

title: The Void
description: When police officer Carter discovers a blood-soaked man limping down a deserted road, he rushes him to a local hospital. As cloaked, cult-like figures surround the building, the patients and staff inside start to turn ravenously insane.

title: The Vow
description: Real-life story of a newlywed New Mexico couple, Kim and Krickitt Carpenter, who were struck by tragedy shortly after their marriage. A car crash puts the wife in a coma, where she is cared for by her devoted husband.

title: The War Below
description: During World War I, a group of British miners are recruited to tunnel underneath no man's land and set bombs from below the German front in hopes of breaking the deadly stalemate of the Battle of Messines.

title: The Warrant: Breaker's Law
description: U.S. Marshal John Breaker and Deputy Bugle Bearclaw find themselves escorting a dangerous criminal to a small town in the Arizona desert where the judge and the banker are barricaded inside the local bank.

title: The Warrior Queen of Jhansi
description: The Warrior Queen of Jhansi tells the true story of the legendary Rani (translation: Queen) of Jhansi, a fearless freedom fighter in India. In 1857, this 24-year old General led her people into battle against the British Empire.

title: The Way Back
description: The Way Back is the critically acclaimed new release from renowned director Peter Weir (Master and Commander, The Truman Show), starring Colin Farrell, Jim Sturgess, Ed Harris, Mark Strong and Saoirse Ronan.

title: The Way Out
description: A young man deals with the loss of his abusive father by taking advice from a charming, dangerous stranger who teaches him about life, sex, and fighting back.

title: The Wedding Arrangements
description: When talented botanist Violet needs help preparing flower arrangements for a high-profile wedding, she calls upon Jack, a handsome nature photographer who has taken over responsibility for his grandfather’s flower shed.

title: The Wedding Fix
description: Reeling from a break-up, professional over-planner Gwen pitches in to help put the finishing touches on her best friend’s wedding. But when she’s teamed up with best man Josh, a free-spirited nature guide, she finds that pulling together this wedding might not be as easy as she thought.

title: The Wedding Guest
description: After Adam gets a call from his ex-girlfriend Allison telling him she is getting married, Adam realises he is just not ready to say goodbye.

title: The Well
description: A young art restorer journeys to a remote Italian village to revive a medieval painting, only to awaken an ancient curse. As myth and brutal pain come alive, her restoration becomes a fight for survival.

title: The Wendell Baker Story
description: When good-hearted ex-con Wendell Baker (Luke Wilson) lands a job in a retirement home, his dreaming and scheming is finally put to good use, helping the elderly residents take down the hotel's evil head nurse (Owen Wilson).

title: The Whistleblower
description: Based on a true story, Kathy Bolkovac (Academy Award-winner Rachel Weisz) is a Nebraskan police officer who takes a job working for the United Nations as a peacekeeper in post-war Bosnia.

title: The White King
description: Djata is a care-free 12-year-old growing up in a brutal dictatorship shut off from the outside world. When the government imprisons his father, Peter, and Djata and his mother Hannah are labeled traitors, the boy will not rest until he sees his father again.

title: The White, the Yellow, and the Black
description: A samurai must guard a sacred pony that is stolen. The samurai will try to retrieve it at any cost with the help of two very unique guys.

title: The Whole Truth
description: Keanu Reeves is a defense attorney trying to clear a teen in the brutal stabbing of his father. As more evidence comes to light, the whole truth seems darker than ever.

title: The Wild
description: The tragic death of their best friend Bea has splintered longtime friends Emilia, Finn, and Lucey, until Emilia convinces them to go on their annual camping trip to reconnect.

title: The Wild Geese
description: Richard Burton, Roger Moore and Richard Harris star as a team of mercenaries hired by a wealthy industrialist for one final mission: Recruit and train a squad of commandos, parachute into an African nation, snatch its deposed President from a prison and escape, and kill anyone who gets in their way.

title: The Window
description: Mina, a 15-year-old Pakistani girl, is given as atonement for her brother's misdeed. Her ruthless spouse imprisons her, leaving her imagination as refuge, while their families' lives collide in a devastating manner.

title: The Winter Lake
description: Tom and his mother are forced to return to an old family farmhouse in Ireland where they befriend their neighbours, the outgoing Holly and her father Ward. When Tom makes a shocking discovery in a seasonal lake, he realises his neighbours have sinister secrets that are beginning to unravel.

title: The Witch
description: 'The Witch' follows a high school student with amnesia as she tries to uncover what has happened to her - leading her into a chilling descent and ultimately revealing a darkness she could not have imagined, as she turns from an innocent teenage girl in to a cold blooded, knife wielding super killer.

title: The Witches of Oz
description: Dorothy Gale discovers that her best-selling novels are actually based on suppressed childhood memories of her time in Oz, and that she may be in danger of experiencing it all over again.

title: The Witness
description: Bill Genovese investigates the 1964 murder of his sister Kitty Genovese, a New York woman who was attacked while 38 bystanders allegedly did nothing to help her.

title: The Wizard's Christmas
description: Long ago in a faraway place, a young wizards apprentice, Alerik, discovers a pathway under the wall of thorns that surround his land to a shining city alive with the magic of Christmas.

title: The Wolf of Snow Hollow
description: A small-town sheriff and his lackluster team of officers is tasked with solving a series of brutal murders that are occurring on the full moon.

title: The Wolf's Call
description: In the near future a French submarine finds itself in a global crisis when a group of terrorists steal a submarine and simulate a nuclear attack.

title: The World We Make
description: 18 year old Lee (a spirited equestrian) and Jordan (an academic and football standout) are at the threshold of building a life together. But their character is tested when racial bias surfaces in their otherwise progressive small town.

title: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet
description: T.S is a 12 year-old prodigy with a passion for cartography and scientific inventions. One day, he receives an unexpected call from the Smithsonian museum telling him that he is the winner of a very prestigious prize.

title: The Young Master
description: Jackie Chan was already a star before The Young Master but this film took him to another level. He plays Dragon who undertakes a mission to find his missing brother, and gets into plenty of scrapes along the way including a case of mistaken identity.

title: There Be Dragons
description: Two childhood friends become separated by the political turmoil of pre-war Spain only to find themselves on opposite sides when the war erupts. One becomes a priest, the other is an activist who becomes a spy for the fascist movement. As the battles are waged, the characters' lives collide...

title: They Were Witches
description: A paranormal radio show host and self-proclaimed witchcraft expert, meets a group of 20-somethings when she stops at a rural motel during a road trip. Soon, they will be murdered, one by one, to bring an evil spirit back from the dead.

title: Thieves and Robbers
description: Tony Roma, a playboy and petty thief living in Florida, witnesses a mob murder. Unfortunately, part of the police force is also colluding with organized crime.

title: Thirteen Days
description: In the midst of the Cuban Missile Crisis, President John F. Kennedy and his chief advisor (Kevin Costner) struggle to prevent nuclear disaster.

title: This Boy's Life
description: A heart breaking coming-of-age story about a boy's abusive relationship with his new stepfather, and his emotionally scarred mother.

title: Thomas & Friends
description: Join Thomas and his friends for carnivals, surprise parties, heroes and hot air balloons. Thomas learns that no special job is more important than friendship and there are ‘Peeps’ and whistles a plenty!

title: Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada
description: Ranch foreman Pete Perkins looks to fulfill the promise to his recently deceased best friend by burying him in his hometown in Mexico.

title: Thunder Road
description: Texan police officer Jim Arnaud struggles to raise his daughter as a love letter to his late mother. A tragicomic portrait of a failing figure of authority in America.

title: Tiger House
description: When Kelly sneaks into her boyfriend's house one night, she soon discovers she isn’t the only unwelcome visitor. A violent gang – lead by determined boss Shane have invaded the property and are holding the family hostage for an unknown ransom.

title: Tiger Raid
description: Tiger Raid tells the story Joe and Paddy, members of a private security crew on a dangerous mission in the Middle East.

title: Tigerland
description: As a nation stands divided over the war in Vietnam, stark differences of opinion surface among the men of A-Company, triggering unexpected and far-reaching consequences.

title: Til Death Do Us Part
description: After bailing on her wedding, a former bride-to-be must fight off her ex-groom and seven angry killer groomsmen in order to survive the night. A suspensful revenge action movie from the creator of Final Destination.

title: Time Addicts
description: Two hapless best friends steal a bag of time-travelling drugs in this dark and kooky sci-fi thriller from the Executive Producer of The Babadook.

title: Time Loop
description: A young Londoner scientist running experiments with his father in a quite Italian village, has to face the consequences of choices he hasn't made yet.

title: Time Out of Mind
description: An increasingly desperate man, George, finds himself adrift on the unforgiving streets of New York City. When he seeks refuge at Bellevue Hospital, Manhattan's largest intake center for homeless men, he befriends a seasoned shelter-dweller.

title: Tina
description: Tina Turner overcame impossible odds to become one of the first female African American artists to reach a mainstream international audience. Her road to superstardom is an undeniable story of triumph over adversity. It's the ultimate story of survival and an inspirational story for our times.

title: To Thy Rest
description: When a Spiritual Medium is called to give a seance at a mysterious hotel in Finland, his sanity is tested as the veil between reality and dream is ripped apart.

title: Today We Kill, Tomorrow We Die!
description: Western film starring Bud Spencer. A man released from prison for a crime he never committed sets out on the trail of the real culprit.

title: Tokarev
description: Nicolas Cage stars in this action-packed thriller as Paul Maguire, a reformed criminal living a simple life as a family man and husband. But Paul is about to discover you can never truly outlive your sins.

title: Tom Cruise: The Last Movie Star
description: Tom Cruise - actor, producer, daredevil. The face of Hollywood in the 1980s, after a mid-career meltdown, his future looked in doubt. But through a single-minded commitment to entertaining audiences worldwide, he has risked life and limb and fought his way back to the very top.

title: Tom Kerridge
description: Tom Kerridge, famed for cooking food that has won him two Michelin stars in his own pub, shows how to cook dishes at home inspired by British pub classics.

title: Tomorrow Morning
description: Tomorrow Morning is the story of one couple seen in two separate timelines, a decade apart. This is a story of life, love, misunderstanding and hope... a universal and timeless tale.

title: Tomorrow's Game
description: On the day of his Uncle's ascendance into the Hall of Fame, Daniel is forced to embark on a journey through time that sees him restore his family's legacy and rewrite baseball history.

title: Too Late
description: This dark mystery thriller follows private investigator Mel (Academy Award nominee John Hawkes) who is tasked with tracking down a missing woman from his own past.

title: Topper
description: A rising comedian falls from grace and finds himself a bitter, hack comic struggling to get by in the cutthroat comedy scene of L.A.

title: Tori & Dean: Cabin Fever
description: On TORI & DEAN: CABIN FEVER, Hollywood power couple Tori Spelling and Dean McDermott head for Canada’s cottage country where they’re determined to transform a lakeside cottage into their dream vacation getaway.

title: Totally Spies!
description: We follow Sam, Alex and Cover, three teenage girls from Beverly Hills as they attempt to balance their normal lives as students with their undercover work as some of the world's best super-spies, battling an array of bizarre criminals.

title: Tour Du Faso
description: Tour Du Faso, Africa's top cycling race, where foreigners and locals try to be the winner on a route full of unforeseen events. This documentary shows us what's beyond this great competition.

title: Tracers
description: It’s a race for survival in the criminal underworld of New York in the action-packed thriller TRACERS.

title: Traces of China
description: Celebrating shared traditions, inventions and artistic influences, this series seeks out the European homes, gardens and public spaces where Traces of China lie hidden in plain sight.

title: Tracker
description: Set in 1903, Tracker is a tense action thriller in which Arjan (Ray Winstone), a guerrilla survivor of the South African Boer War, lands in colonial New Zealand and is promised a huge bounty to capture Kereama (Temuera Morrison), a Maori seafarer accused of killing a British soldier.

title: Trading Paradise
description: From Switzerland to Zambia, via the Amazon and Peru, TRADING PARADISE is a critical behind-the-scenes look at the commodities sector and its ecological and human consequences.

title: Traffic
description: A patchwork of stories about various factions of the drug trade, including dealers, abusers and the law enforcement officials who pursue them.

title: Trafficked
description: Inspired by the award winning book 'Sex Trafficking' by Siddharth Kara, this is the story of three girls from the US, who were trafficked through an elaborate global network of illicit human, organ, and drug traffickers. Trafficked tells their harrowing story as they try to escape their enslavement.

title: Trancers
description: A gruff bounty hunter travels back in time to 1980s Los Angeles to stop a twisted criminal who can transform people into zombie-like creatures.

title: Transference: Dark Mutants
description: Josh is forced to keep his disturbed sister hidden in an underground bunker in order to keep her supernatural powers hidden from the outside world. When she becomes sick, a scientist is hired to help her, but this ultimately leads to the discovery of her amazing superpowers.

title: Transit
description: A gang of bank robbers hide their loot in the car of a family going camping. They chase down the family to kill them and get the loot back, but run into a fight.

title: Transition And Happiness
description: With a sexual reassignment surgery, Rosa Maria, a 59-year-old transsexual woman, seeks to complete her transition after a life of being a traditional macho male. This is her incredible story.

title: Transmission
description: Whilst channel surfing on TV late one night it becomes clear that different stories on different channels are all connected, parts of the same story - a story that must never be told, containing footage that must never be seen.

title: Transvulcania, The People’s Run
description: Transvulcania is one of the most iconic trail running events in the world. It's the race that the local inhabitants feel is truly their own. This documentary delves into the personal stories of the athletes and the island's residents, who have faced years of adversity.

title: Trapped
description: Academy Award® nominees Naomi Watts (King Kong, Mulholland Drive) and Matt Dillon (There's Something About Mary, Crash) star in this thrilling and intense story about a young couple at odds with the American Dream.
